b22642582c2aae225ece.description:
**Remote Health Consultant**

Are you tired of customer service jobs where you read from a script, push products you don’t believe in, and never get to have a real conversation? As a Remote Health Consultant at BodySpec, you’ll be the first voice clients hear when they’re trying to understand their body composition, build a real fitness habit, or finally take their health seriously. No scripts, no pretending the product’s fine. Just real conversations with people who care about their data, and a team that gives you the room to think on your feet. BodySpec is the premier DEXA operator in the country, and our Health Consultants are the heartbeat of that experience.

**First-year Remote Health Consultants in the US can expect to earn up to $49,056 in total cash compensation, plus equity.**

**You'll Love This Job If You Have:**

* **Empathy with Range:** You can meet a curious first-time client and a frustrated rescheduler in the same hour, and both leave the call feeling heard. Your warmth doesn’t sound like a script, because it isn’t one.
* **Health-Literate Curiosity:** You actually care about this stuff. DEXA, body composition, nutrition basics, training principles. These are topics you’d read about on your own time, and that knowledge bleeds through in every conversation.
* **Operational Multitasking:** Phone ringing, three Slack DMs open, an email half-written, calendar pinging, and you don’t drop balls. You hold the cognitive load without getting flustered, and you know which thread to pick up first.
* **Calm Under Volume:** When the queue spikes or a scheduling crunch lands on a Saturday afternoon, you triage by importance rather than by who’s loudest. You don’t perform stress; you absorb it and keep moving.
* **High Agency in a Remote Seat:** Nobody walks by your desk to ask if you’re stuck. When you see a broken process, a wrong FAQ, or a recurring issue, you flag it, fix it, or document it without waiting for someone to assign it.
* **No-Ego Service Posture:** You’re happy to reschedule the same client for the third time, answer the same FAQ for the tenth time, and own the small unglamorous work as fully as the complex problem-solving. The job is the work, not the title.

**What Will You Do?**

* Handle high-volume inbound and outbound client interactions across phone, email, text, and Slack, staying accurate and human on every channel
* Manage appointment scheduling, rescheduling, and cancellations with precision, often dozens per shift
* Answer client questions on nutrition, health, fitness, and DEXA technology with clear, accurate, empathetic guidance
* Partner with our events and operations teams on outbound communications and logistical coordination ahead of scan events
* De-escalate and triage complex or sensitive client situations with composure
* Contribute to ongoing process improvements: flag recurring issues, suggest better workflows, and help refine our CX standards

**Requirements**

* 3+ years of customer experience in a high-volume environment (experience with CX platforms like HubSpot, AirCall, or Zendesk a strong plus)
* Strong working knowledge of CX KPIs, metrics, and best practices
* Proven ability to adapt quickly, learn new systems fast, and pass an internal knowledge and skills assessment within 90 days
* Exceptional written and verbal communication, with natural empathy across a wide range of clients
* Genuine interest in health, wellness, and fitness, enough to learn the science of DEXA and explain it clearly
* Ability to thrive with direct, unfiltered feedback. We’ll tell you exactly what you need to improve
* US-based, with a reliable internet connection and a quiet home workspace
* If you’ve taken standardized tests (SAT, ACT, ASVAB, or similar), share your scores. They aren’t required and won’t be a sole factor, but they help us learn about you since we don’t run pre-employment testing

**Schedule**

* Monday: 1:00 PM to 9:30 PM CST
* Tuesday: 1:00 PM to 9:30 PM CST
* Wednesday: OFF
* Thursday: 1:00 PM to 9:30 PM CST
* Friday: 1:00 PM to 9:30 PM CST
* Saturday: OFF
* Sunday: 1:00 PM to 9:30 PM CST
* Schedule may shift to accommodate business needs

**Compensation**

* **Base Salary:** $41,600 ($20.00/hour at 40 hrs/week)
* **Performance Bonus:** Up to 7% of base salary annually ($2,912); half paid in cash ($1,456), half in stock options
* **Team Revenue Bonus:** $500/month when we hit monthly goals ($6,000 annually; we hit our goals 9 out of 12 months in 2025)
* **Total Cash Compensation:** Up to $49,056
* **Equity:** Stock options through performance bonus and additional grants based on performance

All team members regardless of position are eligible for additional stock option grants and profit sharing based on performance. We expect both cash and equity compensation to grow as the company scales.

**Benefits**

* Health, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k)
* Paid time off
* Sick leave
* Company-wide peer bonus program for recognizing excellent teamwork
* Employee assistance program
* Regular team events (both virtual and in-person)
* Direct mentorship from experienced operators who’ve scaled companies before

BodySpec is transforming how people understand and improve their health through accessible DEXA scanning. As a Remote Health Consultant, you’ll be the first voice our clients hear, guiding them through their data, their questions, and their next step with empathy and precision. If you love talking to people about health, thrive in motion, and want direct feedback that makes you better at your craft, we want to hear from you.

Recycle Track Systems (RTS) was developed with a desire to do better. We are committed to evolving and challenging the waste industry to be better stewards of the environment. Our passion for sustainability and innovation allows for us to guide businesses to a future of reaching a goal of zero waste.

Our technology platform utilizes sensors, GPS tracking, and highly engaged partner haulers to provide waste management and recycling services and track materials from their source to recycling and composting facilities. Our sustainability experts analyze the data generated by the platform to help our customers make tangible improvements to their waste management and recycling efforts. Ultimately, we are innovating to treat waste as a component material for other products in the circular economy so that as little as possible is deposited into landfills or incinerators.

**What we need:**

This position is a customer and hauling partner approach, excelling not only in the delivery of outstanding client support to both internal and external clients but also in actively executing functions related to account management, procurement, and processing service requests within our customer's processes. Your pivotal role involves managing the entire customer life cycle to ensure business retention. The team oversees a book of business, aiming to establish long-term partnerships and improve profit margins for both customers and vendors. At Unifi Healthcare, we are reimagining what healthcare can be—accessible, compassionate, and truly patient-centered. Our mission is to deliver a seamless, personalized experience that empowers individuals and supports them through their healthcare journey, helping people live longer, safer lives in the comfort of their own homes. Through our growing network of services and partners, we are building a model that reduces complexity, supports caregivers, and reimagines how at home healthcare is delivered across the U.S.

Unifi Healthcare manages this search directly. We're not working with outside recruiting agencies on this role, and we won't accept unsolicited candidate submissions or resumes from third parties.

The RN case manager is responsible for ensuring quality patient care via development, implementation, and evaluation, of individual patient care plans within the home setting. The Case Manager serves as the liaison between the Agency and patient families. They are responsible for day-to-day management, coordination, and supervision of the related clinical activities within their assigned service area utilizing professional standards of care and Agency Policy & Procedures. The RN Case Manager reports directly to the Assistant Director(s) of Nursing in their assigned area and to the Director of Nursing utilizing the chain-of-command. Case Managers are expected to create and support positive environments through a personal commitment to the Company’s growth, vision and values.

Location: Lillian, AL

**Essential Functions:**

* Performs documentation/chart review to ensure accuracy and that the client’s POC is being followed. Performs submission of clinical documentation (weekly billing and payroll information) within specified deadlines.
* Maintains accurate information in QuickBase for all assigned clients. Inputs updated information on all assigned clients within a timely manner.
* Manages care implementation with attention to quality patient care and patient family satisfaction.
* Coordinates care authorization with Authorization Specialist(s) to establish the foundation for the development of the client’s treatment plan of care, including new admissions and re-certifications for current clients whom are on-service.
* Provides implementation, evaluation, and oversight of individual patient P.O.C. that corresponds with the physician’s orders through assessment of patient’s needs, condition, environment, and consultation with other health team members.
* Provides education to client regarding benefits, utilizing appropriate team members within the company structure and/or outside agencies to accomplish desired objective. (ie…DME, additional dx, home modifications, medication prior authorizations, etc.)
* Maintains an ongoing responsibility for assigned caseload.
* Attends all pertinent MD appointments with the client (including recertifications, specialists, impairments) as needed, or coordinates coverage within the team if unable to fulfil obligation.
* Builds rapport with patient families in implementing and managing care being rendered.
* Assists staffing department with scheduling work load as needed for maximum efficiency and remains detail oriented to deadlines.
* Maintains open communication with DON, ADON(s), other Case Managers, RN Authorization Specialist(s), non-licensed staff, support staff, and ancillary services. Notifies Scheduling Dept. and ADON(s) of any field related issues involving clients or employees.
* Communicates pertinent information (deaths, hospitalizations, changes in condition, etc…) via email with DON, ADON(s), Operations, Authorizations, Billing.
* Provides clinical guidance and coaching as needed for staff and patient families. Holds field staff accountable for level of care provided.
* Attends monthly Case Management meetings.
* Participates in staff in-service programs/continuing education in-services as scheduled.
* Participates in company designated committees per corporate direction.
* Participates in client home visits in service area per P&P and as needed.

**About the Role**

As a **Client Support Team Lead**, you will lead, develop, and motivate a remote team of 8–12 Client Support Coordinators responsible for delivering personalized service across phone, chat, and email. Reporting to the Client Support Manager, you will drive individual and team performance, strengthen service quality, and foster a collaborative, client-focused culture. You will balance day-to-day operational leadership with coaching, performance management, and continuous improvement while helping your team successfully navigate evolving business needs, processes, and technologies.

* **Drive individual and team performance** by monitoring productivity, quality, client satisfaction, and employee behaviors; leveraging standardized documentation and performance-management practices; identifying opportunities for improvement; and implementing targeted coaching and development plans to achieve operational goals.
* **Manage daily Client Support operations and escalations** by overseeing workflows, scheduling, shift approvals, meetings, and reporting while ensuring appropriate team coverage, operational consistency, and timely resolution of complex or sensitive client concerns.
* **Lead change adoption and continuous improvement initiatives** by translating organizational priorities into actionable team plans, supporting the implementation of new processes and service strategies, developing peer coaches, and partnering cross-functionally to improve the client experience and operational effectiveness.

* Experience supporting recruiting, interviewing, and selection of customer support professionals.
* Experience implementing change-management initiatives, new service processes, or technology improvements within a customer support organization.
* Experience developing peer-coaching programs, facilitating team learning, or supporting employee development initiatives.

3011b4ec2b77b2a7f075.description:
**Reports to:** Vice President of National Accounts  
**Direct Reports:** None

**Position Summary**
====================

The **National Accounts Coordinator** coordinates the launch and ongoing administrative support of National Accounts.

This role owns the account launch process from signed agreement through go-live, ensuring customer requirements, documentation, approved pricing, service coverage, account setup, and billing procedures are complete and communicated. Working closely with National Accounts, Operations, franchisees or service providers, and Accounts Receivable (AR), this role tracks readiness, follows up on outstanding items, and escalates barriers to a successful launch.

After launch, the National Accounts Coordinator supports a consistent customer experience through proactive communication, billing coordination, issue follow-through, and account health tracking. This is a hands-on position requiring organization, initiative, attention to detail, and a willingness to assist without waiting to be asked.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Account Launch Ownership**
----------------------------

* Own and maintain the account launch checklist, timeline, assigned responsibilities, and readiness status from signed agreement through go-live.
* Review customer requirements with National Accounts and Operations and translate them into actionable setup tasks.
* Coordinate required documentation, including signed agreements, service requirements, certificates of insurance (COIs), customer contacts, and billing instructions.
* Confirm approved pricing is documented and accurately reflected in the appropriate systems and customer portals.
* Verify service coverage and responsible service providers with Operations, documenting gaps and escalation contacts before launch.
* Coordinate customer account, location, portal, and work order setup with the appropriate teams.
* Confirm invoice requirements, purchase order procedures, supporting documentation, submission methods, and payment terms with Accounts Receivable.
* Communicate launch requirements and responsibilities to internal teams and participating service providers.
* Track outstanding items, escalate launch risks, and obtain readiness confirmation from responsible teams before go-live.
* Monitor initial work orders and billing activity to identify and resolve early account issues.

**Customer Experience & Communication**
---------------------------------------

* Serve as a central contact for customer updates, administrative questions, service concerns, and billing inquiries.
* Provide timely, accurate updates on scheduling, work status, outstanding items, and issue resolution.
* Track customer concerns with a clear owner, next action, and expected resolution date.
* Coordinate responses with the appropriate team and follow through until issues are resolved.
* Maintain accurate records of customer communication, commitments, and account requirements.
* Escalate concerns that could affect service delivery, customer satisfaction, or the overall account relationship.

**Operations & Billing Coordination**
-------------------------------------

* Facilitate communication between National Accounts, Operations, franchisees or service providers, and Accounts Receivable.
* Monitor open work orders and follow up on missing updates, overdue activity, and incomplete documentation.
* Confirm completed work includes the information required for billing.
* Coordinate resolution of invoice discrepancies, rejected invoices, missing purchase orders, and customer billing questions.
* Track outstanding billing issues and support Accounts Receivable with customer communication and documentation.
* Identify recurring administrative or service gaps and recommend practical process improvements.

**Account Health & Performance Tracking**
-----------------------------------------

* Maintain an account health tracker showing open work orders, response times, completion status, documentation compliance, unresolved customer issues, and billing exceptions.
* Monitor performance against each account's agreed service requirements and flag exceptions promptly.
* Provide regular account status reports to National Accounts and Operations, highlighting overdue items, recurring issues, and actions needed.
* Keep reporting accurate and current so teams can act on account risks.
* Track corrective actions through completion and identify patterns that could affect customer retention or account growth.

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* 2+ years of experience in project coordination, account management, or a related role.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple accounts, tasks, and deadlines simultaneously.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a professional, customer-focused approach.
* Ability to take ownership of follow-up and coordinate work across cross-functional teams without direct supervisory authority.
* Strong attention to detail when handling pricing, documentation, account records, and billing requirements.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, CRM systems, customer portals, and work order platforms.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience supporting multi-location customers, franchise organizations, or field service businesses.
* Familiarity with certificates of insurance (COIs), invoicing, and Accounts Receivable processes.

  

The estimated compensation range for this position is a base salary of $50,200 to $77,800. Actual compensation for the position is based on a variety of factors, including, but not limited to years of experience, skills, qualifications, and geographic location.

6b1cce96fd8ab1d5300a.title: Orthopedic Account Management Specialist
6b1cce96fd8ab1d5300a.description:
At ROMTech, we are transforming rehabilitation through innovative technology and exceptional patient support. We are committed to helping patients achieve better outcomes through Clinician guided at-home rehab while delivering an outstanding experience throughout their recovery journey.

ROMTech is a medical technology company that has created and patented a revolutionary medical device and telemedical platform which delivers in-home rehabilitative care. Our disruptive technology has proven to yield faster recoveries and better outcomes with unmatched patient compliance. We began in orthopedics and have entered scale-up of our orthopedic business. We are now leveraging our core technology, infrastructure, and first mover position to enter cardiology, followed by other adjacent markets. Having created this new lane, we have a unique opportunity to serve as the global leader in the business, technology, and science of recovery, and to bring life-changing help to many millions of people.

**Position Title:** Orthopedic Account Management Specialist  
**Department:** Sales  
**Reports To:** Director of Orthopedic Sales  
**Location / Work Environment:** United States (Work-from-Home)  
**Worker Classification:** W2 Employee  
**FLSA Status:** Exempt  
**Job Level:** Standard

**Job Purpose**
---------------

The Orthopedic Account Management Specialist serves as the primary point of contact for physician offices and Durable Medical Equipment (DME) partners within an assigned territory. This role supports ROMTech’s growth and patient care objectives by ensuring accurate order processing, facilitating communication between provider offices and internal teams, resolving account and patient-related issues, and delivering a high level of customer service throughout the patient journey. The Orthopedic Account Management Specialist helps drive successful patient outcomes by supporting providers utilizing ROMTech’s Clinician guided at-home rehab solutions and ensuring that required documentation, processes, and account activities are completed accurately and efficiently.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Essential Duties**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned physician offices and DME partners, providing responsive support and issue resolution.
* Ensure all W-2 and DME orders are complete and contain all required documentation, including patient demographics, insurance information, clinical documentation, detailed written orders, and Letters of Medical Necessity (LMNs).
* Manage DME orders and coordinate directly with DME partners to resolve documentation deficiencies, order discrepancies, and processing issues.
* Maintain current Medicare and commercial LMNs for assigned prescribing physicians and obtain missing documentation as required.
* Educate and train physicians and office staff on ROMTech ordering processes, documentation requirements, and workflow updates.
* Manage surgery reschedules and cancellations, ensuring accurate documentation and appropriate routing of information within ROMTech systems.
* Coordinate with internal departments to facilitate timely resolution of provider, DME partner, and patient inquiries.
* Manage medical exception requests by gathering required clinical documentation, submitting requests for review, coordinating approvals, and communicating outcomes to stakeholders.
* Process and manage patient write-off requests related to ROMTech errors, obtaining required documentation and approvals.
* Manage Level 1 Intake escalations related to missing order documentation, obtaining records from physician offices and DME partners and uploading documentation into designated systems.
* Manage Level 2 Revenue Cycle Management escalations by obtaining required documentation and facilitating prior authorization processing.
* Review and complete assigned Requests from Other Groups, including logistics issues, surgery changes, order concerns, patient contact issues, and documentation requests.
* Provide billing-related support to physician offices and patients, including explanations of billing processes, patient financial responsibility estimates, and issue resolution.
* Manage patient treatment extension requests by obtaining supporting documentation, coordinating approvals, and ensuring approved treatment time is accurately applied.
* Maintain accurate, complete, and current account information within the company CRM platform.
* Partner with Outside Sales Representatives to onboard new physician accounts and office staff and ensure successful adoption of ROMTech processes.
* Proactively engage physician offices demonstrating reduced prescribing activity to identify opportunities for re-engagement and additional support.
* Generate and distribute monthly account reports, reconcile order activity, identify discrepancies, and obtain outstanding documentation as needed.
* Manage DME SWAP and RMA requests, coordinate approvals, communicate with DME partners, and facilitate resolution and payment processing activities.
* Manage patient prescription requests received through Customer Service or Business Development by coordinating with physician offices to obtain prescriptions and initiate account onboarding activities.

### **Other Functions**

* Participate in process improvement initiatives designed to improve account management efficiency, customer satisfaction, and operational effectiveness.
* Assist with territory-specific projects, reporting initiatives, training activities, and special assignments.
* Support cross-functional teams during periods of increased business need or organizational change.
* Performs other related duties as assigned to support operational and business needs.

**Skills and Abilities**
------------------------

### **Required**

* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong customer service and relationship management abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to analyze issues, identify solutions, and follow through to resolution.
* Proficiency with CRM systems and Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Excel, Word, and Teams.
* Ability to work independently while effectively collaborating with cross-functional teams.
* Ability to handle confidential patient and business information with discretion and professionalism.

### **Preferred**

* Knowledge of healthcare documentation requirements, reimbursement processes, or durable medical equipment operations.
* Experience supporting physician offices, healthcare providers, or medical device organizations.
* Experience working within patient management, intake, revenue cycle, or healthcare operations environments.
* Familiarity with IOMS, CRM platforms, or similar healthcare technology systems.

**Work Experience Requirements**
--------------------------------

### **Required**

* Two (2) or more years of experience in account management, customer success, healthcare operations, sales support, provider relations, patient support, or a related customer-facing role.
* Experience managing multiple stakeholders and resolving customer or account-related issues.

### **Preferred**

* Experience in the medical device, healthcare services, durable medical equipment (DME), orthopedic, rehabilitation, or healthcare technology industry.
* Experience supporting physician practices, provider networks, or healthcare customers.

**Education Requirements**
--------------------------

### **Required**

* None.

### **Preferred**

* Associate’s degree or Bachelor's degree in Business, Healthcare Administration, Communications, Sales, Marketing, or a related field.

**License and Certification Requirements**
------------------------------------------

### **Required**

* None.

### **Preferred**

* Relevant healthcare, customer success, sales operations, or account management certifications.

**Physical Demands and Working Conditions**
-------------------------------------------

**Office Environment**
----------------------

* Ability to sit at a computer terminal for an extended period.
* Moderate noise (i.e., phone calls, online meetings, computer audio).
* While performing the duties of this job, the employee may be regularly required to stand, sit, talk, hear, reach, stoop, kneel, and use hands and fingers to operate a computer, telephone, and keyboard.
* Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision requirements due to computer work.
* Regular, predictable attendance is required.
* Must be able to communicate clearly and professionally in both verbal and written formats.
* Must be able to engage in active listening and express ideas effectively in person, by phone, and via virtual meetings.

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Reasonable accommodation requests must be made in writing by emailing people@romtech.com

9330dc3d8cd385605864.title: Associate Manager, Retail Partnerships
9330dc3d8cd385605864.description:
**About the Team**
------------------

The DoorDash Enterprise Retail team manages the strategic vision, acquisition, and development of the largest retail partnerships in North America. This team sits within the New Verticals Business Development organization. We support our merchant's broader e-commerce strategy, helping them find new ways to acquire, engage with and retain customers. We also love to help our partners solve their operational issues at the lowest level of detail; no job is too big or too small.

**About the Role**
------------------

The Retail Partnerships Senior Associate will help steer the company's effort to adopt and partner with retailers and CPGs at all levels of the sector. eCommerce is expanding, and DoorDash is making meaningful strides to become a leader in this sector. You will report to a Sr. Manager, Retail Partnerships. We expect this role to be flexible in terms of time spent remote, in-office, and traveling to visit merchant partners.

**You're excited about this opportunity because you will…**
-----------------------------------------------------------

* Driving and leading on strategic growth initiatives for your Mx portfolio
* Working with internal product teams to ensure we're prioritizing the right features for our merchants, dashers & customers
* Project managing the rolling out hundreds of stores across the country
* Designing marketing and promotional campaigns for new, returning or churned customers
* Getting into the field to do a test delivery
* Gathering insights on consumer behavior and shopping patterns
* Leading special projects to drive operational efficiency for your partners

**We're excited about you because…**
------------------------------------

* **You're Impact Motivated** - You have a natural desire to improve the overall business
* **You're Curious** - You love digging into low levels of detail to extract insights
* **You're Strategic** - You love to find the win-win in develop novel agreement structures to grow business with partners
* **You're Resourceful** - You are happy juggling many priorities concurrently and being creative with solutions to move fast
* **You're Collaborative** - You enjoy working with lots of different people, both external and internal
* **You're an Owner** - You step up to drive projects forward with minimal supervision

**Qualifications:**
-------------------

* 6+ years of account management, consulting, banking, or strategic partnerships in technology or high growth / early stage startups
* Bachelor's degree required
* Business Development and/or Partnerships experience
* Experience with Analytics and Presentation tools
* Prior investment banking, consulting experience (preferred, not required)
* Proficiency in analytics & visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Sigma, SQL)

We expect this position to be filled by 12/19/2026

**About DoorDash**
------------------

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.  
  
DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees' happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more.

**Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**
---------------------------------------------

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Statement of Non-Discrimination: In keeping with our beliefs and goals, no employee or applicant will face discrimination or harassment based on: race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, age, gender, marital/domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability status, or veteran status. Above and beyond discrimination and harassment based on "protected categories," we also strive to prevent other subtler forms of inappropriate behavior (i.e., stereotyping) from ever gaining a foothold in our office. Whether blatant or hidden, barriers to success have no place at DoorDash. We value a diverse workforce – people who identify as women, non-binary or gender non-conforming, LGBTQIA+, American Indian or Native Alaskan, Black or African American, Hispanic or Latinx, Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander, differently-abled, caretakers and parents, and veterans are strongly encouraged to apply. Thank you to the Level Playing Field Institute for this statement of non-discrimination.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, and any other state or local hiring regulations, we will consider for employment any qualified applicant, including those with arrest and conviction records, in a manner consistent with the applicable regulation.

**If you need any accommodations, please inform your recruiting contact upon initial connection.**

7fab85abe2b0066ab50f.title: Customer Support Associate
7fab85abe2b0066ab50f.description:
**About Us**
------------

Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.

**Reporting to:** Manager, Customer Service

**Location:** Remote

**Schedule:** Full-Time (hours may vary)

  

**About the team:**

Fanatics Collectibles is a new company working at the intersection of collectibles and technology. Backed by some of the best investors, sports properties, and operators in the world, we're integrating with Fanatics' global digital sports platform (inclusive of 900 sports relationships and more than 80 million fans) to reimagine the collectibles business.

  

**About the role:**

Customer Support Associates act as a liaison between Fanatics Collectibles, Inc. and our Collectors as a single point of contact to all Collector inquiries regarding products, policies and services available. This role reports directly to the Customer Service Manager. This is a remote role working EST hours.

  

Collector Support is at the backbone of what Fanatics Collectibles believes in: relentlessly enhancing the Collector experience. As such, these roles have a history of advancement within Fanatics up to the Director level in Customer Experience, Project Management, Brand Management, and more. Above all else, we are looking for proactive, enterprising people that want to work directly with customers and are looking to start a long, successful career within Fanatics. #LI-Remote

  

**What you'll be doing:**

* Liaise between Fanatics Collectibles and Collectors by supporting all inquiries and issues
* Model exemplary service through web message, voice, and email channels
* Delight Collectors: apply good judgement on a case-by-case basis, expedite resolutions, and follow up to ensure satisfaction
* Build and maintain relationships with repeat Collectors
* Develop a thorough knowledge of Fanatics Collectibles' product portfolio and release calendar
* Additional duties as assigned

  

**What we're looking for:**

* Positive, Collector-minded individual with a passion to serve
* General knowledge of trading cards and collectibles industry
* Strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail
* Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills
* Able to multitask, prioritize, and manage time effectively
* Proficiency in MS Suite, including Word, Outlook & Excel
* Familiarity with contact center performance metrics (e.g. AHT, CSAT, NPS, schedule adherence)
* Experience working through web message, voice, and email interactions with customers
* Willingness and ability to work flexible hours, including evenings and weekends, with schedules that adjust quarterly

  

*Ensure your Fanatics job offer is legitimate and don't fall victim to fraud. Fanatics never seeks payment from job applicants. Feel free to ask your recruiter for a phone call or other type of communication for interview, and ensure your communication is coming from a Fanatics email address (including @collectfanatics.com). For added security, where possible, apply through our company website at* *www.fanaticsinc.com/careers*

By submitting your application, you agree to our terms of service and acknowledge you have read our Candidate Privacy Policy.

*Fanatics will never ask candidates for money, banking information, or other sensitive personal information as part of the interview process. If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Fanatics recruiting, please do not respond and report it* *here**.*

8b728e1b892ad86a6f52.title: Retirement Operations Associate, (JPC)
8b728e1b892ad86a6f52.description:
**Who we are:**

Strongpoint Partners is tech-enabled retirement services platform serving small- to mid-sized businesses with integrated retirement third party administration, recordkeeping, payroll, and HR solutions. Recognized as one of Inc. 5000's Fastest Growing Private Companies in America and certified as a Great Place to Work, Strongpoint offers a suite of services that prioritizes accuracy, compliance, and reduction of regulatory risk for its clients, delivered by local client success teams that understand the nuances of the markets they serve. Strongpoint Partners combines a relentless passion for service and innovation with the experience and expertise required to make retirement work for everyone. For more information, please visit: www.strongpointpartners.com.

**About Jocelyn Pension Consulting:**

Jocelyn Pension Consulting (JPC), a Strongpoint Partners operating partner, is a retirement plan investment consulting firm with offices in Boulder, Colorado, and the San Francisco Bay Area. Jocelyn Pension Consulting specializes in helping growing small businesses establish and administer 401(k) retirement plans, providing personalized service and expertise to support clients and their employees. JPC is an operating partner of Strongpoint Partners, a leading tech-enabled financial services retirement platform backed by Shore Capital Partners (SCP).

**Position Summary:**

Jocelyn Pension Consulting (JPC), a Strongpoint partner, is seeking a detail-oriented and motivated **Retirement Operations Associate** to join our Participant Services team. This role supports the day-to-day administration of 401(k) retirement plans, with a focus on participant transactions, client service, and operational processes.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, comfortable with technology, and enjoys problem-solving in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. This is a great opportunity for someone looking to build a career in retirement plan administration while contributing to a growing organization.

*PLEASE NOTE:* *This is a fully* *remote* *position and can be performed from anywhere within the United States; however, the selected candidate will need to accommodate a* *Mountain time* *schedule, (Monday-Friday, 8:30am-5:30pm MT).*

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Review and process participant loan and distribution requests, including hardship withdrawals, rollovers, terminations, and required minimum distributions (RMDs), in accordance with plan provisions and applicable regulations.
* Verify participant eligibility for loans and distributions based on plan documents and participant status.
* Ensure accurate calculation of loan repayment schedules and applicable tax withholdings.
* Prepare daily cash reconciliations, ensuring accuracy and timely resolution of discrepancies.
* Respond to inquiries from plan sponsors and participants regarding loans, distributions, and general 401(k) plan operations.
* Monitor incoming emails and phone calls, providing timely and professional support to plan sponsors and participants.
* Communicate plan rules, procedures, documentation requirements, and processing timelines clearly and effectively.
* Identify opportunities to improve operational workflows, efficiency, and overall service delivery.
* Research and resolve participant and plan-related issues while maintaining a high level of accuracy and customer service.
* Collaborate with internal teams to ensure smooth daily operations and a positive client experience.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications:**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with strong organizational abilities and attention to detail.
* Strong mathematical, analytical, and/or accounting skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and Word.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and work independently.
* Strong initiative, integrity, and a proactive, solutions-oriented approach.
* Comfortable learning new technologies and adapting to evolving processes.
* Ability to communicate professionally with plan sponsors, participants, and other stakeholders.
* Experience working with busy professionals and managing time-sensitive requests.
* Previous experience in retirement plan administration, particularly 401(k) plans, preferred but not required.
* Experience with Sungard Relius and/or Schwab RT preferred.
* Spanish-language proficiency is a plus but not required.

**Pay Transparency Statement:**

The anticipated base salary range for this position is **$50,000–$60,000** annually.

At Strongpoint Partners, our salary ranges reflect the minimum and maximum base pay for the posted position applicable to all locations across the US. Within the posted salary range, individual pay is determined by the geographic location, job related skills, experience, education, and certifications. Our total compensation package includes base pay plus a comprehensive benefits program.

**Our Value-Driven Employee Experience:**

* **Flexible Workplace** – Hybrid and remote options available for many roles.
* **Flexible PTO** – Competitive paid time off, including flexible & unlimited options.
* **Inclusive Environment** – A culture that values diversity, collaboration, and respect.
* **Growth Opportunities** – Support for ongoing learning and career development.
* **Comprehensive Benefits** – Health, dental, vision, life, and disability coverage.
* **Workplace Perks** – Incentive bonus programs, flexible hours, & more.

*\*\*Specific benefits and programs may vary by partner and position.*

e9fb9e3d17340954f6a8.description:
**GENERAL:**  
Sutter O’Connell is dedicated to fearless representation and unwavering client advocacy. Our offices in Cleveland, Nashville and California, along with a dedicated team, handle defense litigation for businesses across the nation, including Fortune 500 companies and major insurers.

We represent globally recognized brands in various industries and have tried, defended, or supervised cases in over 40 states. Our longstanding client relationships reflect our unwavering commitment.

**JOB SUMMARY:**  
The firm seeks talented attorneys who specialize in warranty work and handle litigation matters related to consumer warranty and product liability defense, including "Lemon Law" cases. The qualified candidate will draft legal documents, conduct research, represent clients in court, and collaborate on case strategy. Candidates should possess strong skills in investigation, drafting pleadings, preparing motions, maintaining client contact, developing expert witnesses, and managing discovery.

**Must be located in the San Diego area**

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

The duties of the position include, however, are not limited to, the following:

· Self-directed case management from inception to resolution (under partner) including initial assessment, motion practice, depositions, settlement negotiations and trial prep.

· Prepare for, conduct, and attend hearings, depositions, and draft pleadings, discovery and motions as well as mediations and trials/arbitrations.

· Attend and manage hearings, mediations, settlement conferences and court proceedings.

· Draft pleadings, motions and briefs.

· Analyze, evaluate, synthesize and research case law, statutes, regulations and documents impacting the firm’s clients.

· Conduct legal research regarding complex procedural and substantive issues.

· Interface with clients and opposing counsel in a professional manner.

· Ability to handle complex problems utilizing initiative, creativity and sound professional judgment.

· Organize and manage documents from multiple sources in the court of multidistrict and other complex litigation.

· Build relationships with existing clients, including involvement in networking and business development activities.

· Work within a team and support peer associates.

· Committed to excellent customer service.

· Independently manage assigned cases and docket.

**EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE:**

· J**uris Doctor degree and admission to the California State Bar.**

· Proficient with legal research tools, including Westlaw and LexisNexis.

· **5-8 years of private firm litigation experience.**

· Preferred: Admission to additional state bars.

**SKILLS REQUIRED:**

· Outstanding problem-solving skills.

· Excellent legal writing and oral communication skills. Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

· Positive and enthusiastic attitude, self-motivated and professional.

· Detail-oriented and motivated.

* Ability to work with minimal direct supervision and provide supervision to assigned staff.
* Ability to communicate clearly and effectively – both orally and in writing; Advanced research and writing skills.
* General computer proficiency and keyboarding, including Microsoft Outlook, Excel, and Word.
* Work effectively with other firm attorneys and professional staff.
* **No recruiters or recruiting agencies please**

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $175,000.00 - $200,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Professional development assistance
* Vision insurance

Experience:

* Private firm litigation: 5 years (Required)

Work Location: Remote

6c607d5ef29eb64e054e.title: Sales Associate
6c607d5ef29eb64e054e.description:
TriNet is a leading provider of comprehensive human resources solutions for small to midsize businesses (SMBs). We enhance business productivity by enabling our clients to outsource their HR function to one strategic partner and allowing them to focus on operating and growing their core businesses. Our full-service HR solutions include features such as payroll processing, human capital consulting, employment law compliance and employee benefits, including health insurance, retirement plans and workers’ compensation insurance.  
  
TriNet has a nationwide presence and an experienced executive team. Our stock is publicly traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol TNET. If you’re passionate about innovation and making an impact on the large SMB market, come join us as we power our clients’ business success with extraordinary HR.  
  
**Don't meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that many potential applicants discourage themselves from applying to jobs unless they meet every single requirement. TriNet always strives to hire the most qualified candidate for a particular role, ensuring we deliver outstanding results for our small and medium-size customers. So, if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every single qualification in the job description, nobody’s perfect – and we encourage you to apply. You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles.**  
  
**A Brief Overview**  
As a Sales Associate, you will be responsible for assisting our Sales Consultants in selling our core Professional Employer Organization (PEO) services to new and/or established businesses. This position assists in targeting and converting prospects into clients with their thorough understanding of TriNet's value proposition and their ability to quantify that benefit for clients. Sales Associates will guide documentation, gain appropriate approvals, and validate client information submission for quotation.  
  
**What you will do**

* Submit RFP documents to Risk and Medical Pricing by guiding, assisting, and reviewing client information through TriNet’s portal, following up as necessary to ensure a timely response.
* Work with prospective client to gather and enter data into TriNet’s portal in order to provide accurate and timely pricing quotes.
* Coordinate with other departments for facilitation of requests, documents and information necessary to support the prospective client.
* Run reports and date entry in Salesforce.
* Respond to prospect questions via phone, email or chat providing excellent customer service.
* Reach out to the Sales Consultants on any prospect issues or questions that you cannot address.
* Performs other duties as assigned
* Complies with all policies and standards

**Education Qualifications**

* General education, vocational training and/or on-the-job training preferred

**Experience Qualifications**

* Typically 2+ years of business operations, office, administrative, or sales experience

**Skills and Abilities**

* PEO industry knowledge.
* Excellent verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills.
* Excellent business acumen skills.
* A demonstrated commitment to high professional ethical standards and a diverse workplace.
* Ability to adapt to a fast paced continually changing business and work environment while managing multiple priorities.
* Possess cross-function integration & collaboration skills.
* Strong time management and organizational skills.
* High intellectual curiosity and emotional intelligence.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite and Salesforce.

**Travel Requirements**  
Up to 25% domestic travel may be required  
  
**Work Environment**

* Work in clean, pleasant, and comfortable office or home setting. The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable persons with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

The salary range for this role is $24.81 to $44.65. The candidate’s final salary offer will be based on the candidate’s skills, education, work location and experience.

A candidate’s compensation may also include bonuses consistent with TriNet’s corporate bonus plan.

Additionally, subject to applicable eligibility requirements, TriNet offers permanent full-time employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, and vision plans, life and disability insurance, a 401(K) savings plan, an employee stock purchase plan, eleven (11) Company observed holidays, PTO and a comprehensive leave program. Please click the following link for detailed information about our benefits offerings: https://www.trinet.com/documents/blt5b61a1040aae1904

Please Note: TriNet reserves the right to change or modify job duties and assignments at any time. The above job description is not all encompassing. Position functions and qualifications may vary depending on business necessity.

Any applicant with a mental or physical disability who requires an accommodation during the application process should contact recruiting@trinet.com to request such an accommodation.

afc31ecae5e9bacd49fb.title: In-Home Sales Representative
afc31ecae5e9bacd49fb.description:
**Molly Maid of Surrounding Richmond is growing, and we’re looking for an In-Home Sales Representative to turn interested homeowners into loyal, recurring customers.**

**Every lead is a warm lead.** These are homeowners who have already reached out to us and want help. No cold calling, ever. Your job is to follow up fast, visit their home for an estimate, build trust, and close the sale.

**What You’ll Do**

* Respond to new leads within minutes by phone, text, and email
* Book, confirm, and conduct in-home estimates using the company car
* Present our services and sign up recurring cleaning customers
* Follow up with people who need time to decide
* Schedule one-time cleans (move-in, move-out, special occasions) and follow up to turn them into recurring customers
* Keep every lead and customer record up to date in our scheduling system
* Help with launch, laundry, and office tasks as needed
* Other duties as assigned

**This Role Is a Fit If You...**

* Love talking with people and can build trust quickly
* Stay calm and positive when a customer is upset
* Are comfortable handling objections and asking for the sale
* Follow up without being reminded
* Are motivated by clear goals and earning more when you beat them

**This Role Is NOT a Fit If You...**

* Are uncomfortable going into customers’ homes
* Give up after the first “no” or “let me think about it”
* Take it personally when a customer is frustrated
* Need someone to tell you who to call next
* Want remote work (this role is fully in person)

**Qualifications**

* 1+ year of sales, customer service, or in-home consultation experience
* Clear, confident communicator in person and on the phone
* Comfortable with scheduling or CRM software
* Valid driver’s license, a clean driving record, and ability to pass a background check
* Home services, retail, or appointment-based sales experience a plus

**What We Offer**

* $17/hour plus a monthly bonus: $100–$150 for every new recurring customer you bring on beyond the monthly goal
* Warm, inbound leads. No cold calling.
* Use of a company car for in-home estimates (no wear and tear or gas on your own vehicle)
* 5 paid days off per year
* Full-time, weekdays 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM. No nights.

**How to Apply**

**We hire based on how you handle real situations, not just your resume.**

  

* Submit your resume and answer the application questions.
* After you apply, you’ll receive a short real-world exercise by message. Reply within 48 hours.

Only applicants who complete the exercise will be considered!

932365d46727bfb91664.title: Admissions Coordinator (Mental Health Center)
932365d46727bfb91664.description:
Wings Recovery in Carlsbad, CA is hiring an Admissions Coordinator.

* **Hybrid/Remote position**

Primary Purpose and Function

The Admissions Coordinator serves as the primary point of contact for prospective clients, families, referral sources, and healthcare professionals seeking treatment services at Wings Recovery. The Admissions Coordinator manages prospective clients from initial outreach through assessment, admission decision, and arrival while delivering a seamless experience characterized by empathy, professionalism, responsiveness, and clinical appropriateness.

This role serves as an advocate for prospective clients and families by providing education regarding programs and services, coordinating assessments and admissions, supporting financial and insurance discussions, facilitating communication between internal departments, and ensuring accurate documentation throughout the admissions process.

The Admissions Coordinator sets the tone of respect, compassion, empathy, and urgency from the first point of contact through admission while maintaining the highest standards of ethics, confidentiality, customer service, and regulatory compliance.

Primary Responsibilities Include:

* Serve as the primary point of contact for prospective clients, family members, referral sources, healthcare professionals, and community partners seeking information regarding treatment services.
* Respond promptly and professionally to all inbound leads via phone, email, text message, website submissions, and other communication channels.
* Manage assigned leads and opportunities in a timely and proactive manner to ensure prompt follow-up, exceptional customer service, and progression through the admissions process.
* Build rapport and establish trusting relationships with prospective clients and their support systems.
* Provide comprehensive education regarding Wings Recovery's treatment philosophy, levels of care, clinical programming, therapeutic modalities, and admission criteria.
* Assess caller needs and appropriately communicate program fit, treatment recommendations, and next steps.
* Demonstrate empathy, professionalism, and a sense of urgency while supporting prospective clients and families in crisis or emotionally challenging circumstances.
* Conduct preliminary screening interviews to determine appropriateness for admission and level-of-care considerations.
* Gather and review demographic, clinical, medical, psychiatric, substance use, social, and financial information as necessary to support admission decisions.
* Coordinate and schedule clinical assessments with licensed clinicians and treatment team members.
* Obtain and organize documentation necessary for the admission review process.
* Collect insurance information and facilitate benefits verification processes.
* Review insurance benefits and communicate available coverage information as directed by organizational policies and procedures.
* Other duties as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications

* Minimum one (1) year of experience in behavioral healthcare, admissions, intake, business development, customer service, patient access, or related field required.
* Experience in mental health treatment, residential treatment, behavioral healthcare, or healthcare admissions strongly preferred.
* Experience working with families and individuals experiencing mental health challenges preferred.
* Experience utilizing electronic health records and CRM systems preferred.
* Knowledge of behavioral health treatment services and levels of care preferred.
* Understanding of insurance terminology and healthcare reimbursement processes preferred.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and admissions-related software systems.
* Ability to communicate effectively both verbally and in writing.
* Ability to exercise discretion with confidential information.
* Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with clients, families, referral sources, and team members.

da70134943cee5ad5031.title: Customer Service Rep Call center
da70134943cee5ad5031.description:
**Description**

Penn Medicine is dedicated to our tripartite mission of providing the highest level of care to patients, conducting innovative research, and educating future leaders in the field of medicine. Working for this leading academic medical center means collaboration with top clinical, technical and business professionals across all disciplines.  
  
Today at Penn Medicine, someone will make a breakthrough. Someone will heal a heart, deliver hopeful news, and give comfort and reassurance. Our employees shape our future each day. Are you living your life's work?

**Entity: Corporate Services**

**Department: Call Center**

**Location: 3930 Chestnut Street/Remote \*\* Employees must live within PA, MD, NJ, or DE**

**Hours: Full-Time, M-F 8:30am-5:00pm**

**Summary:**

The Customer Service Representative (CSR)in the Marketing Contact Center (MCC) serves as the "face" of Penn Medicine The position offers excellent patient-centric Customer Service to those seeking guidance and medical assistance from the University of Pennsylvania Health System (UPHS).

The CSR provides information and access to Penn Medicine-owned and affiliated physicians, program services, and educational classes. S/he responds to multi-channel inquiries from patients, physicians, employees, etc., regarding all services offered within the Marketing Contact Center in accordance with established guidelines.

The CSR provides patients and customers with referrals to physicians and services and assists patients with appointment requests via inbound phone calls or online requests and web chat. S/he handles physician-to-physician calls (Physician Link), event and class registration, international calls, cancer calls, and transfer of care requests. In addition, the position is responsible for making outbound calls in response to web or digital marketing campaign inquiries.

The Customer Services Representative must display human qualities of empathy, compassion, kindness, and patience. The position must exemplify Penn Medicine Core Values and exhibit solid Customer Service skills, a patient-centric attitude, a collaborative team spirit, and the ability to think critically and quickly**.**

**Accountabilities**

DAILY RESPONSIBILITIES

* Offers excellent patient-centric Customer Service to those seeking guidance and medical assistance from the University of Pennsylvania Health System (UPHS).
* Answers inbound calls for Penn Medicine Referral Service lines to provide information and access to Penn Medicine owned and affiliated physicians, program services, and educational events; provides resources to callers.
* Provides appropriate and age-specific Penn Medicine resources.
* Gathers information from caller using skills that elicit information for appropriate and efficient responses.
* Provides Penn Medicine patients and customers with referrals to physicians and services and assists patients with appointment requests and other services via inbound phone calls or online requests and web chat.
* Performs searches and uses online reference resources to provide appropriate Physicians/services.
* Facilitates requests for appointment scheduling; provides information and performs appropriate warm transfer.
* Registers callers for events and classes using software (and Pennmedicine.org).
* Obtains/enters demographic information on new callers; verifies demographic information for existing patients.
* Transfers to appropriate nursing staff for calls involving cancer, symptom-based calls, or as per caller request.
* Handles inbound calls for international patients; gathers all required documentation and sends the call content to a follow-up queue for the Penn Global Medicine team.
* Supports the Transfer of Care program.
* Helps facilitate follow-up appointments while the patient is still in the Penn Medicine hospital.
* Receives notification via software from a Penn Medicine provider with patient’s information.
* Contacts patient by phone while they are in the hospital.
* Works closely with requesting Penn Medicine provider to ensure efficiency of appointments.
* Handles physician-to-physician (Physician Link) calls; receives calls from outside Penn Medicine providers seeking to consult with Penn Medicine providers.
* Obtains (calling) physician’s information along with the new or mutual patient’s information and attempts to connect to the Penn Medicine provider via cell phone, text message, or office number.
* (If physicians are connected, the call is complete; if they are not able to connect, the inquiry gets sent to a Referral Nurse follow-up queue for completion.)
* Makes timely outbound calls in response to web, digital marketing campaigns, and other inquiries.
* Responds to online requests from Healthcare professionals and patients to schedule an appointment or access Penn Medicine services.
* Receives a Web Request Form from Healthcare professionals and patients (sent to a Salesforce queue in the MCC and distributed to staff for completion).
* Makes timely outbound call in response to the web request, using documented MCC guidelines.
* Utilizes the Avaya phone application to facilitate communication, including transfers to nurses, schedulers, crossfunctional departments, etc.
* Records all appropriate information in Salesforce concisely and accurately.
* Follows strict medical and legal aspects when offering referrals and performing outbound calls; protects patient confidentiality (HIPAA) at all times.
* Completes call processing efficiently; remains aware of call volumes; works as part of the team to handle the call.
* Supports the onboarding of new-hires; serves as side-by-side instructional guide; supports co-workers collegially.
* Meets Contact Center departmental productivity and process improvement objectives; assists in meeting or exceeding patient satisfaction and operational targets.
* Notifies Marketing Contact Center Manager of administrative or clinical issues and work-related problems.
* Recommends improvement to work processes, software systems, Customer Service, etc., as relevant and appropriate.
* Works as scheduled; demonstrates regular, consistent, and punctual attendance.
* Follows MCC policy requirements for time-off requests.
* Attends and participates in regularly scheduled operational meetings; reviews all minutes.

CUSTOMER SERVICE/HUMAN QUALITIES

* Assists the Marketing Contact Center in maintaining a strong patient/customer focus.
* Supports the delivery of high quality service and shares a passion for patient- and customer-centered care.
* Follows Penn Medicine Customer Service guidelines with all callers.
* Displays human qualities related to empathy, compassion, kindness, and patience.
* Accepts and follows through with constructive feedback, including results of QA monitoring and coaching sessions.
* Discusses work-related issues directly with management; avoids gossiping with co-workers.
* Collaborates willingly with management and co-workers; maintains a positive and optimistic outlook.
* Communicates sensitively with patients having possible hearing difficulties or memory/information processing difficulties.
* Arranges translation services for non-English speaking callers or asks to have an English speaking person confirm needs.

INNOVATION AND PROBLEM SOLVING

* Proactively surveys the environment to determine underlying or hidden problems that may result in potential
* hazards/issues for patients/customers and co-workers.
* Looks beyond the obvious when generating solutions and doesn’t stop at the first answer.
* Approaches problems from an organizational perspective; assesses implications of solutions to UPHS.
* Makes good and timely decisions based on a mixture of analysis, wisdom, experience, and judgment.

COMMUNICATION

* Displays effective professional writing skills.
* Completes forms comprehensively, clearly, and accurately.
* Prepares concise, accurate, and well-organized documentation of encounters, letters, and memos.
* Relays information via the appropriate method (e.g., letter, memo, fax, email).
* Speaks in a professional manner with callers and Penn Medicine co-workers.
* Manages telephone interactions by using appropriate titles and scripts (as appropriate) and by responding to the caller in a prompt, courteous, and informative manner.
* Exchanges clear/concise/accurate information via the most appropriate medium (e.g., face-to-face,
* phone/voicemail).
* Presents ideas and information in ways that others can easily understand.
* Conducts phone interactions using appropriate questioning, listening, clarifying, paraphrasing, and summarizing techniques to obtain accurate information from patients, customers, and staff.

NON-PATIENT CARE

* Participates in entity and department-wide initiatives for patient/employee safety.
* Demonstrates an awareness of patient/employee safety when carrying out daily responsibilities of the position.

UPHS CORE VALUES\*

* Conveys a positive image of UPHS through excellent communication and Customer Service skills to support patients/families and ensure an ideal Patient Experience; assumes accountability for professional demeanor.
* Interacts in a positive manner with staff, physicians, patients, families, and hospital personnel, advocates for patient.
* Recognizes and respects diverse patient and employee populations.
* Is flexible in meeting departmental needs; complies with established departmental and UPHS policies and guidelines.
* Demonstrates productive use of time when not engaged in direct telephone referral activities.
* Uses established channels of communication and ensures understanding of UPHS mission, vision, and values.
* Reviews all relevant and new policies/procedures and integrates into daily work; keeps current with UPHS information.
* Independently writes goals directed toward professional needs; identifies strengths/opportunities for growth/development.
* Is accountable for meeting all mandatory training/education and for documenting attendance.
* Follows the professional guidelines within the UPHS Policy Manual, Professionalism and Standards of Conduct.
* Includes elements of Penn Medicine’s mandatory online course: Rules of Professional Conduct.

Performs duties in accordance with Penn Medicine and entity values, policies, and procedures

Other duties as assigned to support the unit, department, entity, and health system organization

**Minimum Requirements**

**Required Education and Experience**

* High School Diploma/GED (Required)
* Experience with Window applications, phone systems, the Web, and cross system navigation (Preferred)
* Customer Service experience (Highly Preferred)
* Previous work in a Healthcare setting/ Previous experience within Penn Medicine (Preferred)
* Marketing and/or up-sell/cross-sell experience (Preferred)
* Experience with Healthcare systems, e.g., Salesforce, EPIC (Preferred)

We believe that the best care for our patients starts with the best care for our employees. Our employee benefits programs help our employees get healthy and stay healthy. We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits program that includes one of the finest prepaid tuition assistance programs in the region. Penn Medicine employees are actively engaged and committed to our mission. Together we will continue to make medical advances that help people live longer, healthier lives.  
  
Live Your Life's Work

We are an Equal Opportunity employer. Candidates are considered for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, marital status, familial status, genetic information, domestic or sexual violence victim status, citizenship status, military status, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable law.
