Our Sales team is central to the company's growth plan. We are seeking an experienced sales leader with a business development mindset to strengthen its operating foundation, expand books of business, programs, and reactivation, and support the launch of a wholesale channel in 2027.

**The Role**

The Manager, Outbound Sales carries the revenue target for a fully remote team of Value-Added Sales representatives who contact existing customers by phone and text to recommend the products, programs, and packages best suited to their needs. This role owns the pipeline, margin, coaching, offer strategy, and commission plan, and is accountable for building and developing the team that delivers results.

This is a hands-on leadership position within a lean organization. The Manager engages directly with the team, the dialer, and performance reporting each day and has the authority to set schedules, shape offers, and hold the team accountable to its targets. Initial priorities are operational: queue coverage, abandon rate, and consistent production from every representative. Beyond that foundation, the role is accountable for measurable revenue growth driven by business development: reactivating customers, launching programs, and building long-term customer relationships.

**What You'll Own**

***Revenue and Reporting***

* Monthly sales, gross profit, and net revenue targets for the team, managed against the company margin floor
* A concise, reliable weekly performance and forecast view for leadership, sourced from UltraCart today and from HubSpot and Aircall as those platforms are adopted
* Commission plan administration, including accurate and timely payouts and clear communication of results to the team

***Operating Foundation***

* Reduce abandon rate, stabilize queue coverage, and bring every representative to a consistent, fully ramped level of production
* Shift structure, coverage, and schedule adherence across outbound and inbound sales queues
* Team compliance: approved claims language, do-not-call handling, required disclosures, and call recording practices

***Growth***

* Expansion of books of business through outbound outreach, reactivation, and program offers, with guardrails that keep refund and chargeback rates within policy
* A shared customer-contact standard developed with Marketing to prevent over-contact across phone, SMS, and email
* Outbound program management: lead lists and segmentation, dialer campaigns, call cadences, and SMS follow-up, in partnership with Marketing and Lifecycle
* Development and maintenance of the offer playbook, call scripts, objection-handling guides, and reference materials

***Team Leadership***

* Daily management of team KPIs, including dials, contacts, talk time, conversion, revenue per call, average order value, gross profit per call, program and subscription adoption, coupon usage, and refunds
* Coaching through daily live and recorded call review, escalation and closing support, documented coaching logs, and weekly one-on-ones with every representative
* A structured remote team cadence of daily huddles, Slack communication, weekly team meetings, and recognition that keeps a distributed team engaged and accountable
* Recruiting, onboarding, and ramp of new representatives, including a Coordinator feeder and rehire pipeline; performance management and corrective action as needed

### **Requirements**

**What You Bring**

***Required***

* **Business development.** Five or more years in outbound phone sales or business development, with a documented record of owning a revenue target and growing it through prospecting, outbound campaigns, and long-term relationship building. A proven business development track record carries more weight than a sales management title.
* **D2C sales experience.** Direct-to-consumer outbound sales experience by phone in a DTC, direct-response, or subscription business, with a working understanding of how conversion drives average order value, lifetime value, and margin.
* **B2B sales experience.** Outbound phone sales experience selling to businesses, such as B2B SaaS, wholesale, distribution, or retail accounts. This role will support the development of a wholesale channel in 2027.
* **People leadership.** Substantial hands-on experience directly managing and developing a team of sales representatives, including hiring, ramping, and building a feeder or rehire pipeline.
* **Margin management.** Experience managing to gross profit per call, contribution margin, and refund and chargeback rates, not solely top-line revenue.
* **Coaching.** Demonstrated ability to coach through call observation and direct feedback, sell consultatively, communicate performance expectations clearly, and develop representatives accordingly.
* **Integrity.** A record of leading teams that achieve targets through ethical, consultative selling, and the judgment to identify and address sales conduct that does not meet company standards.
* **Systems and tools.** Hands-on proficiency with dialer and telephony platforms, call recording and quality assurance tools, SMS outreach, and CRM or contact-center systems, along with strong Excel or Google Sheets skills for building scorecards and forecasts.
* **Commission plans.** Experience administering sales commission plans and managing pay cycles accurately.
* **Compliance.** Working knowledge of TCPA and telemarketing regulations, do-not-call compliance, and FTC and DSHEA guidance governing dietary supplement claims.

***Preferred***

* Health, wellness, or dietary supplement industry experience
* Outbound sales experience in home services, consumer packaged goods, food distribution or food service supply, or short-term rental property management
* Subscription, free trial, or continuity business model experience
* Experience designing sales commission plans
* HubSpot, Aircall, or UltraCart experience
* Bachelor's degree in business or a related field

### **Benefits**

**Compensation and Benefits**

Base salary $77,000 to $87,000, plus an uncapped, performance-based variable incentive plan tied to team revenue and margin results. Remote with a flexible schedule and genuine work/life balance. Medical, dental, and vision insurance. 401(k) with a 3.5% match. Life and disability insurance. Flexible PTO. Discounts on HBI products.

*If you have grown revenue through outbound business development, led the team behind it, and want to be paid on how much it grows, we would love to hear from you.*

f964a76195244088847b.title: Content Management and Operations Lead (Drupal)
f964a76195244088847b.description:
**Content Management and Operations Lead (Drupal)**
===================================================

**Job Number: 984**  
  
**This is a remote position.**

Ad Hoc is a technology company that empowers organizations to deliver scalable, impactful digital services. Using modern, agile methods, our team creates products that meet people’s needs and transform their experience of government.

**Work on things that matter**

Our collaborations have shaped some of the defining moments in public-sector service delivery. We’ve helped build products that connect Veterans to tailored services, help millions access affordable health care, and support important programs like Head Start. As we work with agencies to deliver critical services, we’re also changing how the government approaches technology.

**Built for a remote life**

Our culture, communications, and tools are built for remote work, enabling us to bring together top talent nationwide. At Ad Hoc, remote life empowers our teams to design work environments that fit their lives and that foster flexibility and collaboration to achieve positive outcomes for our customers.

**Committed to high expectations and a welcoming culture**

Ad Hoc values acceptance, accountability, and humility. We aren’t heroes. We learn from our mistakes and improve the process for the next time. We build small, inclusive teams to collaborate closely with our partners to solve the right problems and deliver software that works.

The **Federal Civilian** business unit supports many customers spanning the federal, commercial, and nonprofit space. Our customers include NASA, the General Services Administration, Office of Personnel Management, the Library of Congress, Health & Human Services, and the FDIC. We partner with these agencies to build new capabilities, deliver products, establish data as a strategic asset for informed decision-making, modernize legacy systems, and build the digital service infrastructure necessary to scale their mission impact.

**Role Overview**

Ad Hoc is seeking a Content Management and Operations Lead (Drupal) to lead content operations supporting a federal financial regulatory web services program. This position is responsible for the day-to-day management of the content operations team, including staff supervision, workload prioritization, quality assurance, performance management, and operational delivery.

The customer's mission depends on timely, accurate, and accessible communication with audiences ranging from individual consumers to financial institutions and investors. Publishing time-sensitive regulatory information requires exceptional attention to detail, strong operational discipline, and a commitment to accuracy.

In this hands-on leadership role, you will directly supervise the team responsible for developing, reviewing, publishing, and maintaining web content in Drupal. You will establish operational priorities, manage team performance, and implement the standards, workflows, and governance practices necessary to ensure the customer's digital content is accurate, accessible, secure, and delivered on time.

You will serve as a key operational leader and subject matter expert in Drupal content administration, editorial workflows, information architecture, and publishing operations. Working directly with the customer's Web Team and content coordinators across multiple divisions, you will provide leadership and guidance on content structure, accessibility, usability, and Drupal authoring best practices.

You will also oversee content operations supporting major website initiatives, including feature launches, awareness campaigns, redesigns, and content modernization efforts. This position requires someone who can balance people leadership, strategic planning, and hands-on technical expertise while maintaining accountability for service delivery in a deadline-driven federal environment.

**Primary Responsibilities**

**Primary expectations of a Content Management and Operations Lead include:**

* Directly manage and supervise a team of content specialists, including assigning work, establishing priorities, providing coaching and performance feedback, conducting performance evaluations, and supporting professional development.
* Oversee daily content management operations, including intake, prioritization, workload distribution, quality assurance, and publication of content requests across the public website and intranet, ensuring established service-level agreements (SLAs) are met.
* Manage staffing capacity, resource allocation, workload distribution, and operational coverage to ensure the team meets customer requirements and program commitments.
* Establish clear performance expectations, monitor team productivity and quality metrics, identify performance gaps, and implement improvements to strengthen operational effectiveness.
* Serve as the program's Drupal content management subject matter expert, providing technical leadership and oversight of content types, fields, taxonomies, media libraries, menus, navigation, layouts, editorial workflows, moderation states, and user permissions.
* Oversee website content maintenance and administration, including redirects, metadata, menus, and page layouts within Drupal, providing hands-on support for complex or high-priority requests and coordinating with development teams when custom functionality is required.
* Develop, document, implement, and enforce content governance standards, publishing procedures, editorial workflows, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
* Ensure published content and templates comply with Section 508 and Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.x standards, overseeing accessibility testing, issue resolution, and remediation activities.
* Lead and coordinate training for government stakeholders and content coordinators on Drupal authoring, information architecture, page layouts, content organization, usability, accessibility, and publishing best practices.
* Manage content planning and operational delivery for major initiatives, including website redesigns, feature launches, content migrations, and high-visibility communications campaigns.
* Partner with design, development, and program leadership to establish content requirements, improve content models, and support enhancements to website functionality and user experience.
* Oversee content-related site search functionality, including metadata, taxonomy, search configuration, and optimization to improve content discoverability.
* Leverage web analytics and operational performance metrics to evaluate content effectiveness, monitor service delivery, identify trends, and drive improvements to content organization, accessibility, and user experience.
* Direct and coordinate confidential and time-sensitive publishing activities, including regulatory announcements and bank closing events, ensuring strict adherence to customer security requirements, release procedures, and quality standards.
* Collaborate with development, DevSecOps, design, quality assurance, and third-party teams to coordinate releases, incidents, upgrades, and other activities affecting content operations.
* Maintain oversight of team assignments, deliverables, and operational documentation using Jira, Confluence, or equivalent customer-approved tools, contributing to weekly status reports, monthly SLA reporting, and quarterly performance reviews.
* Lead operational planning, participate in Agile ceremonies, and coordinate cross-functional activities to support efficient and predictable content delivery.
* Identify and address operational risks, resource constraints, quality concerns, and workflow inefficiencies, escalating issues to program leadership as appropriate.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to strengthen publishing efficiency, content governance, team effectiveness, and the overall quality of the customer's digital presence.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience in web content operations or content management for large, public-facing websites, including demonstrated experience directly supervising employees or managing content publishing teams.
* Demonstrated experience managing team performance, assigning and prioritizing work, coordinating staffing resources, providing employee feedback, and maintaining accountability for operational delivery.
* 3+ years of hands-on experience administering or building content within Drupal 9, 10, or 11, including content types, fields, taxonomies, Views, media management, menus, Layout Builder or Paragraphs, content moderation, editorial workflows, and user roles and permissions.
* Strong working knowledge of HTML and CSS, with working familiarity with JavaScript sufficient to troubleshoot rendered content and template-related issues.
* Demonstrated experience implementing and maintaining Section 508 and WCAG accessibility standards, including hands-on testing using assistive technologies such as NVDA, JAWS, or VoiceOver.
* Experience developing, implementing, and enforcing content standards, editorial workflows, publishing procedures, and SOPs.
* Experience managing content operations against established SLAs, including accountability for measurable accuracy, response time, resolution, and quality expectations.
* Experience using web analytics platforms such as Google Analytics 4 (GA4) or equivalent tools, along with site search configuration and optimization.
* Experience working within Agile delivery environments using Jira, Confluence, or equivalent project management and collaboration tools.
* Strong organizational and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities, resolve operational challenges, and maintain team accountability in a deadline-driven environment.
* Excellent written, verbal, leadership, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to advise nontechnical stakeholders, provide training, and establish clear operational standards.
* Ability to obtain and maintain the required federal background investigation and Public Trust suitability determination.
* Must meet applicable contractual citizenship or lawful permanent residency requirements.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience managing content operations teams supporting large-scale Drupal website redesigns, modernization, or replatforming initiatives, including content audits, inventory management, content modeling, template mapping, restructuring, migration, and post-launch support.
* Acquia Certified Drupal Site Builder certification or equivalent Drupal certification.
* Experience supporting federal government websites, particularly within financial regulatory agencies.
* Familiarity with the 21st Century Integrated Digital Experience Act (IDEA), OMB Memorandum M-23-22, and the U.S. Web Design System (USWDS).
* Experience administering Drupal within a FedRAMP-authorized hosting environment, such as an appropriately authorized Acquia, Pantheon, or Cloud.gov environment.
* Familiarity with Git-based Drupal configuration management, including configuration export/import processes and CI/CD release workflows.
* Experience with structured content, content strategy, information architecture, and federal plain-language standards.
* Experience managing digital assets and overseeing PDF accessibility remediation using Adobe Acrobat or equivalent tools.
* Experience managing confidential, embargoed, or time-sensitive publishing events requiring strict quality controls and coordinated release procedures.
* Experience overseeing operational performance reporting, resource planning, and continuous improvement initiatives within a federal government contract environment.

**To learn more about working at Ad Hoc, please visit:** https://adhocteam.us/join

**Benefits:**

* Company-subsidized health, dental, and vision insurance
* Flexible PTO
* 401K with employer match
* Paid parental leave after one year of service
* Employee Assistance Program

Ad Hoc LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, age, pregnancy, disability, work-related injury, covered veteran status, political ideology, marital status, or any other factor that the law protects from employment discrimination.

We value the unique skills gained through military service and encourage veterans and transitioning service members to apply.

In support of various state and city equal pay transparency laws, Ad Hoc job descriptions feature the starting range we reasonably expect to pay to candidates who would join our team with little to no need for training on the responsibilities we've outlined above. Actual compensation is influenced by a wide range of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and responsibility. The range of starting pay for this role is $110,000-$155,000, with ultimate salary commensurate with experience and qualifications. Our recruiters will be happy to answer any questions you may have, and we look forward to learning more about your salary requirements.

e0a86d4009b8fa3af358.title: Director, Delivery Assurance | RCM Operations
e0a86d4009b8fa3af358.description:
**About Our Company:**  
At Infinx, we're a fast-growing company focused on delivering innovative technology solutions to meet our clients' needs. We partner with healthcare providers to leverage automation and intelligence, overcoming revenue cycle challenges and improving reimbursements for patient care. Our clients include physician groups, hospitals, pharmacies, and dental groups.  
We're looking for experienced associates and partners with expertise in areas that align with our clients' needs. We value individuals who are passionate about helping others, solving challenges, and improving patient care while maximizing revenue. Diversity and inclusivity are central to our values, fostering a workplace where everyone feels valued and heard.

**A 2025 Great Place to Work*****®***

In 2025, Infinx was certified as a Great Place to Work*®* in both the U.S. and India, underscoring our commitment to fostering a high-trust, high-performance workplace culture. This marks the fourth consecutive year that Infinx India has achieved certification and the first time the company has earned recognition in the U.S.  
  
**Location: Remote** or Hybrid in Houston, TX or New Orleans, LA preferred  
  
**Summary Description**

The Director – Revenue Cycle Operations serves as the Revenue Cycle Management domain lead within the Strategic Delivery function and is responsible for ensuring successful operational design, implementation, stabilization, and transition of strategic client engagements. The role provides deep functional expertise across billing, charge entry, payment posting, accounts receivable, denials, appeals, collections, and related back-end revenue cycle functions. Primary accountability includes translating contractual commitments and client expectations into executable operating models, validating workload and staffing assumptions, supporting operational readiness, resolving delivery challenges, and helping strategic engagements achieve defined service, quality, productivity, and financial outcomes. This position works closely with Customer Success, Onshore and Offshore Operations, Product, Technology, Quality, Training, Compliance, and client stakeholders. Direct ownership of routine steady-state production is not the primary focus. Strategic Delivery involvement will typically extend from contract execution through implementation and the initial stabilization period, followed by structured transition to the designated Operations team with periodic delivery assurance reviews thereafter.

**Job Responsibilities**

* **Strategic Delivery & Implementation**
  + Lead Revenue Cycle delivery planning for strategic client implementations and complex operational transitions
  + Translate contract scope, client expectations, workflows, volumes, and service requirements into executable operating plans
  + Conduct operational discovery and validate assumptions before implementation
  + Perform detailed inventory analysis across AR, billing, denials, payment posting, charge entry, and related workflows
  + Develop effort estimates, productivity assumptions, staffing requirements, skill profiles, and capacity models
  + Identify operational risks, dependencies, access requirements, and implementation gaps before go-live
  + Establish implementation milestones, readiness criteria, ownership, and escalation pathways
  + Partner with Patient Access and Coding Strategic Delivery leads to ensure end-to-end alignment across the revenue cycle
* **Revenue Cycle Domain Leadership**
  + Provide subject matter expertise across charge entry, claims submission and billing, payment posting, AR follow-up, denial management and appeals, collections, credit balances and refunds, payer follow-up, reimbursement workflows, and inventory management
  + Evaluate existing client workflows and recommend scalable, efficient operating models
  + Analyze payer behavior, aging trends, denial patterns, reimbursement issues, and revenue leakage opportunities
  + Support Operations teams with complex functional issues and critical client escalations
  + Recommend solutions based on operational data, root-cause analysis, and industry best practices
* **Pre-Go-Live Readiness**
  + Validate scope, volumes, productivity benchmarks, staffing assumptions, and client expectations prior to launch
  + Support workforce planning, hiring profiles, candidate assessment, and staffing readiness
  + Define operational service levels, key performance indicators, quality expectations, turnaround times, and productivity standards
  + Ensure process documentation and standard operating procedures are complete and aligned with contractual requirements
  + Support development and validation of training programs, knowledge assessments, and operational readiness plans
  + Confirm system access, payer portal access, reporting requirements, workflow queues, and client dependencies
  + Partner with Product and Technology teams to validate product configuration and workflow readiness
* **Go-Live & Delivery Assurance**
  + Provide hands-on delivery leadership during strategic client go-lives
  + Establish and lead daily governance during critical implementation periods
  + Monitor production volumes, inventory, backlog, quality, productivity, turnaround time, and staffing utilization
  + Support production planning and workload prioritization
  + Coordinate resolution of operational, product, system, workflow, access, and training issues
  + Provide functional guidance to Onshore and Offshore Operations teams
  + Participate in client implementation and delivery meetings as needed
  + Maintain structured risk, issue, dependency, and action tracking
  + Escalate material risks with clear recommendations, owners, and recovery plans
* **Stabilization – First 90 Days**
  + Lead delivery assurance through the initial stabilization period for assigned strategic engagements
  + Monitor performance against agreed SLAs, KPIs, productivity, quality, and financial expectations
  + Conduct root-cause analysis for recurring operational issues and implement corrective action plans
  + Review staffing against actual production demand and recommend adjustments where appropriate
  + Identify training gaps and facilitate targeted retraining or knowledge reinforcement
  + Ensure SOPs remain current as workflows evolve during implementation
  + Partner with Operations leadership to build independent delivery capability
  + Drive timely resolution of customer concerns and delivery escalations
  + Support account-level gross margin improvement by identifying operational inefficiencies and staffing opportunities
* **Transition to Steady-State Operations**
  + Develop and execute a structured transition plan to the designated Onshore or Offshore Operations team
  + Ensure complete knowledge transfer, documentation, training, reporting, and ownership before handoff
  + Establish clear steady-state roles and responsibilities across Operations, Customer Success, Product, and support functions
  + Define exit criteria and validate operational readiness before Strategic Delivery ownership is reduced
  + Continue periodic delivery assurance reviews for strategic accounts following transition
  + Re-engage when material delivery risk, escalation, or performance deterioration is identified
* **Performance Management & Analytics**
  + Establish performance scorecards for strategic implementations and stabilization programs
  + Monitor and analyze key RCM indicators including Days in AR, aging distribution, denial rates, clean claim rate, first-pass yield, collection efficiency, cash acceleration, productivity, quality, backlog, and turnaround time
  + Convert operational data into recommendations, corrective actions, and measurable improvement plans
  + Provide concise executive reporting on implementation status, risks, client impact, and required actions
* **Client & Stakeholder Governance**
  + Serve as a senior operational subject matter expert for strategic client engagements
  + Participate in implementation calls, operational reviews, MBRs, QBRs, and escalation discussions as required
  + Partner closely with Customer Success to ensure client commitments are reflected accurately in operational delivery
  + Maintain strong alignment between client expectations, contractual commitments, product capabilities, and operational execution
  + Present solution-oriented recommendations rather than only identifying delivery problems
  + Support customer confidence through strong domain expertise, structured communication, and timely resolution of issues
* **Product, Technology & AI Enablement**
  + Partner with Product teams, including RCM+, PA+, and other relevant platforms, to align technology capabilities with client workflows
  + Identify opportunities for automation, artificial intelligence, workflow optimization, and reduction of manual effort
  + Translate operational pain points into clearly defined product requirements and improvement opportunities
  + Support testing, workflow validation, and implementation of new technology capabilities
  + Capture recurring operational issues that may warrant product or process redesign
* **SOP, Training & Knowledge Management**
  + Ensure complete and current SOPs are developed for assigned strategic engagements
  + Build repeatable delivery playbooks and implementation standards
  + Facilitate knowledge transfer between client-facing, onshore, and offshore teams
  + Ensure critical knowledge is institutionalized rather than dependent on individual resources
  + Conduct post-implementation lessons-learned reviews
  + Translate lessons learned into improvements to SOPs, training materials, workflows, implementation frameworks, and product capabilities
* **Global Delivery Collaboration**
  + Partner with Offshore Operations leadership to establish scalable delivery models for strategic engagements
  + Support offshore readiness, skill development, staffing, training, and knowledge transfer
  + Ensure alignment between onshore and offshore teams on scope, workflows, performance expectations, and escalation protocols
  + Provide domain guidance during complex production or client situations
  + Facilitate transition of work to offshore teams where appropriate while protecting service quality and client expectations
  + Support development of standardized operating rhythms across geographies
* **Continuous Improvement & Delivery Excellence**
  + Identify recurring delivery gaps across strategic accounts and develop repeatable solutions
  + Promote standardization across client implementations while accommodating legitimate client-specific requirements
  + Develop reusable templates, checklists, dashboards, and delivery playbooks
  + Support development and continuous improvement of the Strategic Delivery operating framework
  + Identify opportunities to improve scalability, quality, productivity, customer satisfaction, and gross margin

**Job Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Healthcare Administration, Business Administration, Finance, or related field
  + Master’s degree in Healthcare Administration, Business Administration, or related field
* 10+ years of progressive experience in healthcare Revenue Cycle Management
* 5+ years in a leadership, consulting, implementation, transition, or operational transformation capacity preferred
* Deep hands-on knowledge of end-to-end physician and/or ambulatory RCM workflows
* Strong experience across billing, payment posting, AR, denials, appeals, collections, and reimbursement processes
* Demonstrated experience leading complex client implementations, operational transitions, or performance improvement initiatives
* Proven ability to analyze inventory, volumes, productivity, staffing requirements, and operational capacity
* Experience developing SOPs, training frameworks, operational controls, and performance metrics
* Demonstrated success resolving complex delivery issues and client escalations
* Experience working with global or offshore delivery teams strongly preferred
* Experience partnering with Product and Technology teams on workflow automation or digital transformation initiatives preferred
* Strong understanding of payer processes, reimbursement methodologies, denial management, and revenue cycle performance indicators
* Relevant certifications preferred, such as:
  + Certified Revenue Cycle Representative or equivalent
  + Lean Six Sigma or process improvement certification
  + Project management or transition management certification
* Deep Revenue Cycle Management domain expertise
* Strong critical thinking and structured problem-solving capability
* Strong operational and financial analytical skills
* Ability to translate client requirements into scalable operating solutions
* Strong implementation and transition management capability
* Executive-level communication and presentation skills
* Strong customer-facing and stakeholder-management capability
* Ability to influence cross-functional teams without direct reporting authority
* Strong understanding of operational performance metrics and analytics
* Strong documentation, SOP, and knowledge-transfer capabilities
* Ability to operate effectively across Onshore and Offshore teams
* Strong change-management and escalation-management capability
* Ability to work effectively in ambiguous, high-growth, and rapidly changing environments
* Solution-oriented mindset with strong focus on customer outcomes
* Experience with major RCM platforms, practice management systems, electronic health record systems, payer portals, workflow tools, and reporting platforms
* Working knowledge of automation and AI applications within Revenue Cycle Management preferred
* Ability to travel approximately 20–30% for strategic client implementations, operational workshops, training, and escalation support

**Success Measures**

* Strategic implementation readiness and go-live success
* Time to operational stabilization
* SLA and KPI achievement
* Quality and productivity performance
* Accuracy of staffing and effort estimates
* Reduction in delivery escalations
* Effective transition to steady-state Operations
* Knowledge-transfer and SOP completion
* Client satisfaction and delivery confidence
* Operational scalability
* Contribution to account gross margin improvement
* Identification and implementation of automation and process improvement opportunities.

**Company Benefits and Perks:**  
Joining Infinx comes with an array of benefits, flexible work hours when possible, and a genuine sense of belonging to a dynamic and growing organization.

* Access to a 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan.
* Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage.
* Paid Time Off.
* Paid Holidays.
* Additional benefits, including Pet Care Coverage, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), and discounted services.

If you are a dedicated and experienced Revenue Cycle Operations Leader ready to contribute to our mission and be part of our diverse and inclusive community, we invite you to apply and join our team at Infinx.

d6adb7329b4b9e27a147.description:
**Role Snapshot**  
The Senior Overpayment Recovery Specialist will assist the Overpayment Recovery Team with work direction, workflow, inventory, and coordination of activities and processes within the department. The role will advise and assist employees in the unit and support the resolution of difficult or complex issues.

**Additional Information**

* **Starting Base Salary**: **$ 24.00/hr. (may change with experience)**
* **Training Location/Schedule:**
* Formal training first two weeks, with non-formal training after. Training shift is either 7:30am-4pm CT or 8am-4:30am CT.
* **Scheduled Shift****:** Production hours 6am-8pm CT. 8-hour shift within this time frame.
* **We are open to remote work in the following approved states:**  
  Colorado, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, Nebraska, New Jersey, North Carolina, Ohio, South Carolina, Texas, Virginia, Wisconsin

**How do I know this opportunity is right for me? If you enjoy the following:**

* Assist supervisor with monitoring, working, analyzing, and escalating department workload inventories for timely handling.
* Assist supervisor with mentoring new employees and providing process training.
* Support the preparation of daily, weekly, and monthly operations reports, including those related to Recovery Audit activities.
* Assist with interpretation of regulations and development/revision of work instructions and process manuals.
* Research and respond to complex Overpayment Recovery or financial case situations.
* Perform audits and/or quality reviews of unit completed work.
* Assist with and/or participate in departmental internal and external audit processes, including OMB-A123, SSAE-16, ISO Surveillance, and Internal Audit reviews.
* Assist with ensuring jurisdictional process consistency, including process manuals and work instructions. Provide technical assistance by identifying and reporting system problems and testing system changes.
* Ensure compliance with Federal Privacy Act, HIPAA, and WPS conflict of interest and confidentiality requirements within daily work assignments.
* Provide necessary back-up by performing duties assigned to the Payment Recovery Representative, Payment Recovery Specialist, Reimbursement Analyst, Senior Reimbursement Analyst, and MSP Senior Analyst.
* Other job-related responsibilities may be assigned as required.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* High School Diploma or equivalent.
* Two (2) or more years Medicare Financial/Overpayment Recovery experience with proficiency in all overpayment recovery areas, or applicable adjustment experience in other WPS contracts.
* Demonstrated knowledge of Overpayment Recovery Regulations, including coordination of benefits, financial cash receipts/recovery regulations and procedures, HIGLAS system, claims processing guidelines, edit resolution, and online systems.
* Knowledge of how to interpret regulations and apply them to process manuals, work instructions, and departmental guidelines.
* Knowledge of internal/external audit procedures, quality review standards, and audit documentation requirements.
* In-depth knowledge of insurance, payment recovery, reimbursement processes, and overpayment case workflow.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for mentoring staff, preparing reports, and documenting procedures.
* Skilled in researching and resolving complex financial or recovery-related case situations with sound judgment.
* Ability to train new employees, provide ongoing coaching, and support team development.
* Ability to collaborate effectively in internal and external audit activities and support cross-functional teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Previous experience in a formal or informal leadership capacity, including but not limited to providing guidance, coaching, mentoring, or supporting team members.

**Remote Work Requirements**

* Wired (ethernet cable) internet connection from your router to your computer.
* High speed cable or fiber internet.
* Minimum of 10 Mbps downstream and at least 1 Mbps upstream internet connection (can be checked at https://speedtest.net (https://speedtest.net/)).
* Please review Remote Worker FAQs (https://secure.wpsic.com/files/remote-work-faqs.pdf) for additional information.

**Benefits**

* Remote work options available
* Performance bonus and/or merit increase opportunities
* 401(k) with a 100% match for the first 3% of your salary and a 50% match for the next 2% of your salary **(100% vested immediately)**
* Competitive paid time off
* Health insurance, dental insurance, and telehealth services start **DAY 1**
* Professional and Leadership Development Programs

WPS, a health solutions company, (https://www.wpshealthsolutions.com/about/index.shtml) is a leading not-for-profit health insurer and federal government contractor headquartered in Madison, Wisconsin. Valeris is a fully integrated life sciences commercialization partner that provides comprehensive solutions that span the entire healthcare value chain. Formed by the merger of PharmaCord and Mercalis, Valeris™ revolutionizes the path from life sciences innovation to real-life impact to build a world in which every patient gets the care they need. The company is headquartered in Morrisville, North Carolina and Jeffersonville, Indiana. To learn more about Valeris, please visit www.valeris.com.

Key Responsibilities:

The responsibilities include, but are not limited to the following:

Answer high-volume inbound call inquiries from patients, care team, and healthcare providers regarding patient assistance program eligibility criteria, patient specific enrollment status, or refill related requests for already enrolled patients.

Timely processing of Patient Assistance enrollment applications:

Review of patient assistance enrollment forms and any supporting documentation to assess patient eligibility for participation as per SOPs and program guidelines

Determination of patient’s eligibility based upon program criteria for qualification.

This may include some form of insurance benefits verification to determine eligibility for assistance.

Actively listen to each customer, assess needs, and respond with demonstrated patience and courtesy.

Review and identification of information that is missing and/or incorrect within program service requests/program applications.

Reporting of Adverse Events/ Product Complaint inquiries received in accordance with SOP and good manufacturer practices.

Provides timely feedback to the company regarding service failures or customer concerns

Effectively uses our internal technology platform, Lynk, to complete claims processing and keep workflows moving.

Patient Assistance Care Coordinators are expected to be patient focused and committed to providing the highest quality customer service all while maintaining a sense of compliance and commitment to abiding by company policies and procedures.

Team members are expected to meet all call quality metrics, as well as maintain expected levels of call handling and processing metrics. This is a fast-paced, patient focused role.

Utilize Valeris’ values as the driving force behind the team’s success

On time adherence to training deadlines for all corporate policies and procedures

Ensure all SOPs are followed with consistency

Perform additional tasks or projects as assigned

Qualifications:

The candidate must possess the following personal attributes:

Service minded; focus on recognizing and meeting the needs of others (especially patients and care partners)

Ability to handle personal health information with confidentiality

Commitment to honesty and integrity

Professionalism and a strong sense of proper business and customer service etiquette

Clear verbal and written communication skills

Accountability for results

Ability to plan and prioritize tasks and strong attention to detail

Proficient emotional intelligence (ability to recognize emotions and their effects)

Ability to manage disruptive impulses and handle potentially stressful customer interactions

Proficient computer skills

Adaptability to change

Personal initiative and commitment to team and organizational goals

Ability to work effectively within a team

A positive attitude!

Associate’s or Bachelor's degree strongly preferred or equivalent experience required; completion of a high school diploma or GED is required

6 months customer service experience, payer benefits experience (reimbursement, prior authorization, etc.), healthcare industry experience or healthcare related certification, license, or equivalent coursework is strongly preferred

This is an office-based position, the ability to sit for extended periods of time is necessary

Although very minimal, flexibility to travel as needed is preferred

Physical Demands & Work Environment:

The employee is frequently required to sit for long periods of time, use hands to type, handle or feel; and reach with hands and arms. Prefer candidates who can type at least 35 words per minute with 97% accuracy.

Although very minimal, flexibility to travel as needed is preferred.

This job operates in a professional office environment. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, etc.

Opportunities for advancement in a company that supports personal and professional growth

A challenging, stimulating work environment that encourages new ideas

Work for a company that values diversity and makes deliberate efforts to create an inclusive workplace

A mission-driven, inclusive culture where your work makes a meaningful impact

9f5a7dbaae9678340099.title: Benefits Support Coordinator
9f5a7dbaae9678340099.description:
**Job Title**: Part-Time Benefits Support Coordinator

**Reports To**: Benefits, Leave, and Workers' Compensation Manager

**Position** **Type**: Part-Time, Non-Exempt

**Schedule**: Monday through Friday, 4 to 5 hours per day. Flexible scheduling is permitted, provided the Team Member works the mandatory core hours: 8:00 AM – 12:00 PM PST / 9:00 AM – 1:00 PM MST / 10:00 AM – 2:00 PM CST / 11:00 AM – 3:00 PM EST.

  

#### **Position Summary**

The Part-Time Benefits Support Coordinator provides highly experienced administrative and operational support to the internal benefits team. Drawing on a strong background in human resources, this role assists the Benefits, Leave, and Workers' Compensation Manager and the Benefits Specialist by managing routine inquiries, troubleshooting issues, and maintaining precise records. By handling front-line communication, ticket management, and data reporting, this coordinator enables the senior team members to focus on complex claims, strategic administration, and regulatory compliance.

  

#### **Essential Responsibilities**

##### **Team Member Support & Issue Resolution**

* Manage the shared benefits email box, ensuring all Team Member inquiries are addressed promptly and accurately.
* Monitor, route, and resolve Team Member requests and issues submitted through SolarWinds ticketing software.
* Serve as the first point of contact for Team Member inquiries regarding health, dental, vision, and life insurance benefits.
* Handle complaints and grievances with a pleasurable attitude and excellent customer service, ensuring team members feel heard and supported.
* Escalate the most complex benefit, leave, or workers' compensation issues to the Benefits, Leave, and Workers' Compensation Manager.

##### **Benefits & Leave Administration Support**

* Enter and maintain accurate records related to benefits plan participation and contributions within the HRIS.
* Assist the Benefits Specialist with the meticulous reconciliation of monthly carrier bills against payroll deductions.
* Help coordinate Team Member communication materials and prepare presentations or memos for the annual open enrollment process.
* Aid the Benefits Specialist in the intake and administration of the first report of injury for Workers' Compensation claims.
* Ensure routine leave forms and paperwork are filed correctly to assist the Specialist in coordinating timelines with third-party administrators.

##### **Data Management & Reporting**

* Utilize advanced formulas and data management techniques to build, maintain, and analyze reports.
* Assist in maintaining up-to-date internal documentation and standard operating procedures (SOPs) for the benefits department.
  

#### **Qualifications**

* Experience: Minimum of 5 to 6 years of proven experience in Human Resources or Benefits administration.
* Technical Skills: Proficient use of Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets, including advanced formulas and data management for reporting and analytics. Familiarity with HRIS and payroll systems is highly preferred, alongside experience with SolarWinds or similar ticketing systems.
* Customer Service: Exceptional customer service skills and a pleasurable attitude, with a demonstrated ability to professionally and empathetically handle Team Member complaints and grievances.
* Attributes: Meticulous attention to detail and proven discretion when handling confidential Team Member information.
* Abilities: Ability to multi-task, prioritize daily workflows, and build collaborative relationships.
  

#### **Work Environment & Physical Demands**

* Environment: Incumbents work in an office environment.
* Equipment: This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, and filing cabinets.
* Physical Activity: The Team Member is regularly required to use hands to finger, type, handle, or feel and talk or hear.
* Movement: The Team Member is frequently required to sit, stand, walk, reach with hands and arms, and stoop or squat.
* Lifting: The Team Member must be able to push, pull, lift, carry, or maneuver office products and supplies of up to twenty (20) pounds.
* Vision: Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

Equal Opportunity Employer

378f27fd0f9f6f86458e.title: Phlebotomy and Customer Service Specialist Parkesburg (Full Time/Day Shift)
378f27fd0f9f6f86458e.description:
**Description**

Penn Medicine is dedicated to our tripartite mission of providing the highest level of care to patients, conducting innovative research, and educating future leaders in the field of medicine. Working for this leading academic medical center means collaboration with top clinical, technical and business professionals across all disciplines.  
  
Today at Penn Medicine, someone will make a breakthrough. Someone will heal a heart, deliver hopeful news, and give comfort and reassurance. Our employees shape our future each day. Are you living your life's work?  
  
LOCATION: Parkesburg, PA (Parkesburg Outpatient Lab)

HOURS: Full Time (32 hours/week) Day Shift. Flexibility needed during operational hours. Hours of operation are Monday & Tuesday 6:30 am- 6:00 pm. Tuesday, Wednesday, & Friday between:30am and 5 pm. Rotational Saturday between 8am and 12 pm. Closed Sundays and major holidays. 6-8 weeks of full -time training.

Summary:

* Provides complete and accurate patient scheduling, registration, insurance verification, ordering of tests and coordination of applicable screening, diagnostic, physician office and outpatient hospital services. Capable of coordinating and communicating effectively during increased volumes or with complex patients. This position requires clinical skills in the following functional areas: phlebotomy, EKG, holter monitors, point-of-care testing and specimen collection. Maintains required competency skills.
* Qualified individuals must have the ability with or without reasonable accommodation to perform the following duties:
* Phlebotomy
* Performs venipuncture and capillary specimen collection in an ambulatory setting.
* Validates patient identity, specimen integrity and maintains working knowledge of specimen requirements and all clinical protocols
* Documents all stages of specimen collection in required computer systems including investigating and processing orders, “receiving” specimens, canceling tests, running collection lists and producing and using reconciliation reports.
* Maintains clinical skills necessary to perform duty job.
* Completes cleaning tasks utilizing regulatory standards.
* Performs maintenance and or inventory of equipment and supplies according to unit department standards.
* Registration
* Performs complete and accurate patient registration including but not limited to walk in, check-in, and or scheduled appointments.
* Demonstrates ability to successfully adapt and perform during times of high volumes and or high patient acuity. Demonstrates skill to service both inpatient and outpatient, if necessary.
* Supports inbound and outbound calls to or from patients, guests, or appropriate parties as needed to provide services. Screens and accurately relays messages using protocols established for emergent, urgent and non-urgent calls.
* Verifies patient, guarantor, coverage and hospital account information. Performs required referral authorization processes and enters orders for applicable tests.
* Understands insurance company coverage and referral authorization requirements of payors. Performs electronic and manual verification of insurance coverage and understands how to read and accurately apply electronic insurance responses.
* Prepares and or releases records or orders in the e-Health record. Scans all necessary documents into appropriate medical record. Understands the importance of patient’s medical information that is documented on paper.
* Completes assigned patient scheduling and registration work queues according to performance standards. Ability to resolve work queue issues and missing registration items via electronic medical record.
* Disseminates or discusses information with the patients regarding co-pays, out of pocket expenses, pre-appointment preparation, arrival times, etc.
* Understands and supports Point of Service Collections. Performs all necessary functions needed to collect patient financial obligations.
* The following duties are considered secondary to the primary duties listed above:
* Additional clinical procedures including but not limited to: EKG, holter monitors, 24 hr Blood pressure or vital signs.
* Other duties as assigned.

Responsibilities:

Minimum Required Qualifications:

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Completion of educational requirements additional formal education training; maximum supervision for initial competency; yearly competency evaluation and training .
* CPR Certification - American Heart Association AHA Basic Life Support, formerly Healthcare Provider AHA Heart Saver courses for CPR are not accepted required within 30 days of hire.
* One 1 year of clerical, customer service, or administrative support experience in a highly customer-oriented organization.
* One 1 year experience with basic keyboarding, personal computer use, and other office setting equipment.

Preferred Qualifications

* Previous phlebotomy or registration experience. Training will be provided upon hire.
* One 1 year of Epic or equivalent Electronic Medical Record experience.

  
We believe that the best care for our patients starts with the best care for our employees. Our employee benefits programs help our employees get healthy and stay healthy. We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits program that includes one of the finest prepaid tuition assistance programs in the region. Penn Medicine employees are actively engaged and committed to our mission. Together we will continue to make medical advances that help people live longer, healthier lives.  
  
Live Your Life's Work

c7801b0c35d93ef815ee.description:
Overview:

Planned Systems International (PSI) is an Enterprise IT services company who focuses on designing, building, securing, and operating cutting-edge software solutions that drive mission success and operational excellence for Federal Government organizations. PSI is currently seeking a Federal Acquisition Support Manager to join a Program Management Office (PMO) Support team supporting the VA Loan Guaranty (LGY) Product Line.

This critical role primarily focuses on supporting the LGY Government Contracting Officer's Representative (COR) team with contract administration activities, monitoring contract deliverables and invoice approvals, coordinating acquisition documentation, and serving as the primary contract-management resource for software development and operations efforts.

The position is a contractor support role within a PMO Support Team and serves as a vital bridge among Government program personnel, procurement organizations, budget/finance personnel, and the IT contractor. The ideal candidate will possess strong experience in federal contracting, experience supporting federal programs or COR functions, and the independent judgment to translate evolving requirements into clear contract-management actions in a fast-paced environment.

Essential Functions and Job Responsibilities:

* Support a Government program team in contract administration activities for federal contracts and task orders supporting VA LGY Product Line initiatives.
* Lead the development of contract documentation through the entire acquisition lifecycle, from initial requirements development to submission of compliant procurement packages.
* Monitor monthly contract deliverables; coordinate review, disposition, and approval by the appropriate Government authorities; and verify alignment with contractual requirements, schedules, quality standards, and program objectives.
* Serve as a primary contract-management resource for the COR team, providing contract guidance and interpretation to internal teams, contractors, and Government stakeholders.
* Facilitate and lead recurring contract status meetings with VA leadership, program managers, CORs, Contracting Officers (COs), budget personnel, and contractor personnel, serving as an interface between the IT contractor and Government stakeholders.
* Coordinate closely with budget and finance personnel to track contract funding across Contract Line Item Numbers (CLINs) and support budget planning, execution, and funding-related contract actions.
* Maintain accurate contract documentation, acquisition records, action items, status reports, meeting minutes, and milestone tracking.
* Help manage and track contract-specific processes for initiating, planning, and executing mission-specific work, including optional-task activities and associated documentation.
* Utilize Jira, Microsoft SharePoint, and other project management tools to manage project activities, monitor workflows, track deliverables, maintain documentation, and facilitate issue resolution across teams and stakeholders.
* Coordinate across program management, budget/finance, procurement and procurement-support organizations, technical teams, and contractor personnel to advance contract actions and meet program and procurement timelines.
* Identify contract risks, performance concerns, funding issues, and process gaps, and use independent judgment to recommend practical mitigation and resolution approaches.
* Support contract modifications, invoice review and approval tracking, vendor coordination, performance evaluations, and compliance reporting.
* Draft, edit, review, and coordinate contract and acquisition documentation, including Performance Work Statements (PWSs) sections, in-scope determinations/memoranda, Justifications and Approvals (J&As), and related acquisition artifacts; support budget personnel in the development and review of Independent Government Cost Estimates (IGCEs).
* Apply federal acquisition knowledge and independent judgment to evolving program needs, identify required contract-management actions, and recommend practical paths forward in a fast-paced environment.
* Translate program and technical requirements into clear contract-related documentation and procurement-ready acquisition artifacts for Government review.
* Provide advisory and technical support to CORs and PMO leadership on acquisition, contract-management, and program-support matters.
* Facilitate stakeholder communication and build working consensus among program, acquisition, budget, technical, and contractor teams when requirements, interpretations, priorities, or trade-offs differ.
* Support Government stakeholders in applying the Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR), Veterans Affairs Acquisition Regulation (VAAR), agency policies, and contractual requirements.
* Conduct research on special topics and recommend solutions to government clients.
* Facilitate executive-level virtual meetings, including preparing meeting agendas, capturing minutes, and tracking outcomes and action items.
* Work proactively and independently to carry out assignments to completion within parameters of instructions given, prescribed routines, and standard accepted practices.
* Function as part of an integrated team sharing products, best practices, and information across the PMO Support Team.
* Perform related duties as assigned by supervisor.

Minimum Requirements:

* Bachelor’s degree.
* At least 8 years of total professional experience with 5+ years in federal acquisition, contract management, COR support, and/or federal program/PMO support, preferably supporting IT modernization projects.
* Federal acquisition certifications (FAC-C, FAC-C Professional, FAC-COR).
* Strong knowledge of Federal acquisition and contract-support documentation for IT or professional services contracts, the Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR), Government budgeting and procurement lifecycles
* Experience supporting Independent Government Cost Estimates (IGCEs), contract modifications, and contract administration support processes
* Advanced experience in strategic planning and analysis for acquisition activities, requirements planning, and stakeholder management across program, technical, budget, and acquisition communities
* Experience collaborating with CORs, COs/Contract Specialists, Budget personnel, PMO leadership, and contractor teams.
* Experience working on multiple concurrent acquisition actions and program/technical requirement translation for contract and procurement purposes.
* Experience in Federal PMO/program support and coordination activities
* Demonstrated ability to: articulate complex contract requirements, options, and trade-offs clearly; manage detailed documentation with exceptional attention to accuracy; work effectively in fast-paced, evolving program environments; bridge program, technical, budget, and acquisition communities; and maintain organization across multiple concurrent projects.
* Ability to communicate effectively with diverse stakeholder groups and exercise sound independent judgment when direction is incomplete or evolving.

Desired Qualifications:

* Familiarity with Veterans Affairs Acquisition Regulation (VAAR) strongly preferred.
* Proficiency in project management tools (e.g., JIRA, MS Project) and methodologies.
* Experience with Veterans Affairs or other federal agencies a plus.
* Experience working in a contractor support role alongside Government acquisition and program personnel a plus.

Physical Demands:

* Ability to effectively communicate in English, including talking and hearing.
* Ability to operate productively in a fully remote work environment, including the ability to take meetings and phone calls from a quiet and private space during business hours.
* Ability and willingness to actively participate in virtual meetings throughout most of the workday and be responsive to messages (MS Teams) and emails (MS Outlook) within reasonable timeframes set by the supervisor or client.
* Ability to be responsive and working during Eastern time zone standard business hours (8:00am to 4:00pm EST).
* Ability to satisfy security clearance and onboarding requirements:
  + Print, sign, scan, and return onboarding documentation.
  + Travel at personal expense to nearest government facility to get fingerprinted, apply for a PIV badge, pick-up the PIV badge, and pick-up government equipment.

Additional Information:

**Professional Certifications**

* Federal acquisition certifications (FAC-C, FAC-C Professional, FAC-COR)

**Required Technical/Business Tools**

* MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams)
* MS SharePoint
* MS Visio
* Jira or comparable development management tool

Company Benefits:

PSI offers full-time, benefits eligible employees a competitive total compensation package that includes paid leave, and options for employer sponsored group medical, dental, vision, short-term and long-term disability, life insurance, AD&D coverage, legal services, identity theft, and accident insurance. Flexible spending account and health saving account options offer pre-tax savings for qualified medical, dental, and vision expenses. The company sponsored 401(k) retirement plan has an employer contribution match that is immediately vested. We invest in the professional growth of our employees through professional courses, certifications, and tuition reimbursement programs.

EEO Commitment:

It is company policy to promote equal employment opportunities. All personnel decisions, including, but not limited to, recruiting, hiring, training, promotion, compensation, benefits, and termination, are made without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, pregnancy, gender identity, genetic information, national origin, citizenship status, veteran status, protected veteran status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Resumes submitted via email, social media, referrals, recruiting events, or other means will not be considered an official application and must be accompanied by a completed online application in the ATS before a candidate can be considered for employment.
  
  
Reasonable accommodations for applicants and employees with disabilities will be provided. If a reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, or to receive an update regarding the status of your application, please contact Talent Acquisition by emailing talent@plan-sys.com, or by dialing 703-575-8400.
