*Are you passionate about* ***improving*** *the quality of healthcare?*

*Are you ready to* ***leverage your talents*** *to make healthcare better for everyone?*

*Do you want the opportunity to* ***give back*** *to your community?*

*Do you want to have* ***fun at work****?*

Then **join** the growing team at Health Services Advisory Group (HSAG) that is transforming the delivery of healthcare in the United States!

**SUMMARY**

HSAG is nationally recognized as an industry leader in the areas of healthcare audits, data analysis, measure development, and survey research. We are in search of talented individuals who are interested in a leadership position healthcare analytics and data science as a **Director, Audits** in HSAG’s Medicaid Services division. Together we can spread positive change to make healthcare better.

**UNIQUE BENEFITS**

The Director, Audits position benefits from HSAG’s desire to grow its staff into future leaders of healthcare quality improvement in the nation. The Director provides leadership within the Medicaid Services division across the entire array of healthcare audit projects. The Director, Audits position will supervise the Performance Measure Validation (PMV) and Healthcare Effectiveness Data and Information Set (HEDIS®[1]) staff in the Audits department.

HSAG offers:

* A comfortable work-life balance, including flexible work schedules.
* Three weeks of paid time off and 13 company-paid holidays where staff leave two hours early prior to each holiday to get a “jump start” on holiday festivities.

HSAG offers a competitive benefit package that includes medical, dental, vision, tuition reimbursement, 401(k) and an employee stock ownership plan.

**DESCRIPTION**

The **Director, Audits** positionis a key leader responsible for providing management oversight and leadership on HSAG’s broad spectrum of audit projects. The Director, Audits will provide operational oversight of all HSAG PMV and HEDIS® audit activities. On a daily basis, this position manages multiple large-scale and high-profile audit projects through various stages including implementation, day-to-day management, budgeting, forecasting, analysis, and reporting. Activities include overseeing multiple teams in developing work plans and timelines; leading and overseeing project tasks; leading client teleconferences and meetings; presenting on healthcare topics; supervising and/or mentoring junior staff; and providing regular progress reports to the Senior Executive Director, Medicaid Services. The Director, Audits will also lead responses to requests for proposals (RFPs) and implement formal training series for junior and senior staff under the direction of the Senior Executive Director.

Details regarding potential project assignments and key sources of data will be discussed with potential candidates during the interview process.

  

**ESSENTIAL COMPETENCIES, DUTIES, AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Serve as the team leader on the PMV and HEDIS teams and senior leader within HSAG’s Medicaid Services division.
* Provide operational oversight of PMV and HEDIS audit activities as a leader on the HSAG Audits Team.

* Act in a liaison capacity between HSAG and state Medicaid agencies and organizations.
* Direct project planning, implementation, and performance monitoring across scope, staffing, schedules, budgets, and deliverables for the Audits department.
* Lead and coach auditors and other assigned staff by setting expectations, monitoring performance, supporting development, and fostering accountability and collaboration.
* Ensure customer deliverables are accurate, high quality, internally reviewed and approved, and submitted on time.
* Leverage tools such as SharePoint and Copilot to streamline workflows and improve deliverable production.
* Monitor financial performance, including staffing plans, labor utilization, budgets, and forecasts, in coordination with Finance and executive leadership.
* Identify and mitigate operational, contractual, staffing, and customer risks; escalate significant concerns to the Senior Executive Director.
* Participate in the oversight of analytic output from partnering divisions.
* Develop and adhere to analytic project time and task schedules, identify opportunities to improve the project process, and develop quality improvement activities accordingly.
* Conduct Internal Quality Control (IQC) monitoring regarding efficiency/effectiveness of activities conducted. Present issues and recommended solutions and take corrective actions as indicated.
* Assist in the contracting process, including the development and review of contract language, scopes of work, and budgeting.

* Define appropriate audit approaches.

* Present and communicate project results to nonanalytic staff members and customers.
* Represent HSAG in a professional manner at all times.

**EDUCATION AND/OR EXPERIENCE**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience in the area of Medicaid managed care, HEDIS, performance measures, and/or audits.
* Credentialed as an NCQA Certified HEDIS Compliance Auditor (CHCA) or proficiency in HEDIS reporting.
* At least fifteen (15) years of work experience.
* At least ten (10) years of healthcare experience, preferably Medicaid.
* Budget and cost proposal development experience, including leading cost proposal development.
* Contract development and review experience.

**OTHER QUALIFICATIONS**

* Expertise in Medicaid, health plan operations, or managed care.
* Expertise in evaluating medical and prescription drug claims and encounters; eligibility and enrollment; demographic; survey; and vital statistics data required. Experience evaluating electronic health record and clinical data preferred.

* Demonstrated ability to supervise a team including responsibility for monitoring and evaluating performance.
* Excellent English/communication skills (i.e., spelling, composition, grammar, proofreading and editing).
* Strong public speaking skills.
* Excellent interpersonal skills.
* Proficient in Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Outlook and Copilot.
* Ability to lead several large projects simultaneously and lead multiple analytic teams working on disparate activities.

0d79c853c98d5eca70e0.title: Medical Data Quality Analyst
0d79c853c98d5eca70e0.description:
**Be visionary**

Teledyne Technologies Incorporated provides enabling technologies for industrial growth markets that require advanced technology and high reliability. These markets include aerospace and defense, factory automation, air and water quality environmental monitoring, electronics design and development, oceanographic research, deepwater oil and gas exploration and production, medical imaging and pharmaceutical research.

We are looking for individuals who thrive on making an impact and want the excitement of being on a team that wins.

**Job Description**

**Position Summary:**

**Teledyne Brown Engineering (TBE) is seeking a Medical Data Quality Analyst** to provide subject matter expertise and conduct data management and analysis for military medical systems, Prolonged Casualty Care (PCC), patient treatment protocols, and medical supplies to join our Medical Modeling and Simulation (MM&S) team in support of the Naval Health Research Center (NHRC).

The MM&S team provides software engineering, modeling and simulation development, analysis, technical support, and training for medical systems analysis, logistics analysis, operational risk assessment, and theater medical course-of-action assessment across the Department of Defense (DoD).

In partnership with NHRC, TBE develops a suite of modeling and simulation tools that includes: the Medical Planners’ Toolkit (MPTk), the Joint Medical Planning Tool (JMPT), the Expeditionary Medical Knowledge Warehouse (EMedKW), and other tools. These tools support casualty treatment and evacuation analysis, medical resource allocation, risk assessment, casualty estimation, and mission-readiness analysis.

**The responsibilities of this position include, but are not limited t**o:

* Review military medical data used within MM&S team software for accuracy, completeness, consistency, and operational relevance.
* Curate, analyze, and maintain Prolonged Casualty Care data, including treatment activities, timing and sequence of care, resource utilization, patient status, and outcomes relevant to delayed evacuation or resource-constrained environments.
* Translate approved patient treatment protocols into structured data elements, treatment profiles, decision logic, and supply requirements used by medical planning and simulation applications.
* Update supply collections associated with patient treatment profiles and monitor changes to medical allowance standards and National Stock Number medical materiel.
* Validate software outputs against source data, clinical expectations, operational assumptions, and documented treatment protocols.
* Provide subject matter input on underlying medical, clinical, operational, and logistics data used by modeling and simulation tools.
* Conduct and support multidisciplinary reviews of datasets used to inform simulation models and expeditionary medical planning analyses.
* Investigate data anomalies, document findings, and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Review academic, clinical, and operational literature to identify relevant military medical data and changes to treatment practices.
* Maintain metadata, data dictionaries, controlled vocabularies, data lineage, and standardized reporting formats.
* Maintain data related to personnel, medical allowance standards, equipment sets, treatment capabilities, patient care, and expeditionary clinical operations.
* Provide expertise on expeditionary medical treatment, patient care, patient outcomes, triage, and prolonged field care considerations.

**Required Qualifications**

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in a medical, clinical, health sciences, biomedical, nursing, emergency medicine, or closely related field.

**Required Experience**

* 5+ years of relevant experience in military medical data management preferred.
* Experience working in military medical treatment environments, including deployed, expeditionary, operational settings.
* Demonstrated experience working with Prolonged Casualty Care data, prolonged field care data, or equivalent clinical data involving extended treatment, delayed evacuation, and limited resources, and the impact of these on patient physiological status.
* Experience interpreting, applying, documenting, or maintaining patient treatment protocols, clinical practice guidelines, standing operating procedures, or standardized treatment pathways.
* Experience connecting clinical treatment requirements to data elements such as interventions, medications, supplies, equipment, personnel, treatment duration, evacuation timing, and patient outcomes.
* Experience reviewing medical data for quality, clinical validity, traceability, and fitness for analysis, modeling, simulation, or decision support.
* Experience with patient care, trauma care, emergency medicine, critical care, combat casualty care, or expeditionary medicine.

**Core Competencies**

* Ability to communicate clinical and operational concepts to software engineers, system engineers, data specialists, modelers, logisticians, and government stakeholders.
* Strong written communication, technical documentation, research, and analytical skills.

**Preferred Skills and Experience**

* Familiarity with Uniformed Services medical allowance standards and Defense Health Agency and Service specific medical data systems.
* Familiarity with Defense Logistics Agency data systems, including Medical Contingency Requirements Workflow (MCRW).
* Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel, relational databases, and data-query or data-quality tools.
* Experience with medical research, clinical data analysis, operational medicine research, or health-data management.
* Knowledge of data validation, quality control, configuration management, and documentation processes.
* Experience with expeditionary medical planning, operations, logistics, casualty estimation, or patient movement.
* Experience with triage procedures and treatment protocols for mass-casualty events.
* Experience with medical readiness, manpower, supply, or logistics data systems.
* Familiarity with MPTk, JMPT, EMedKW, or comparable medical modeling and simulation tools.
* Ability to quickly learn new software tools, data structures, and clinical or operational domains.

**Clearance and Citizenship**

* Must be a U.S. Citizen.
* Must possess or be able to obtain a DoD Security Clearance.

**Location and Travel**

* Remote position with frequent face-to-face meetings at NHRC in San Diego, California.
* Candidate must live within driving distance of NHRC in San Diego, California with the ability to support short-turn requests for face-to-face meetings at NHRC.
* Periodic travel to Huntsville, Alabama or additional locations for training, meetings and conferences.

**Candidate Profile**

The strongest candidate will combine direct military expeditionary medical experience with the ability to convert clinical knowledge into accurate, structured, traceable data. The individual should understand management of data quality and how patient treatment protocols and Prolonged Casualty Care affect treatment timelines, staffing decisions, supply consumption, equipment utilization, evacuation prioritization decisions, and patient outcomes in operational environments.

**Salary Range:**

$90,800.00-$121,100.000

The anticipated salary range listed for this role is only an estimate. Actual compensation for successful candidates is carefully determined based on several factors including, but not limited to, location, education/training, work experience, key skills, and type of position.

Teledyne conducts background checks on qualified applicants who receive a conditional offer of employment in accordance with applicable laws, regulations and ordinances. Background checks may include, but are not limited to, education verification, employment history and verification, criminal convictions, Motor Vehicle Report (MVR & driving history), reference check, credit checks/credit history and drug testing. All qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.

Teledyne and all of our employees are committed to conducting business with the highest ethical standards. We require all employees to comply with all applicable laws, regulations, rules and regulatory orders. Our reputation for honesty, integrity and high ethics is as important to us as our reputation for making innovative sensing solutions.

Teledyne is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status, age, or any other characteristic or non-merit based factor made unlawful by federal, state, or local laws.

Forward-thinking and committed, we find the best solution and use the right technologies to design, develop and manufacture your products to ensure we get vital medicines to patients quickly and safely.

  

We are dedicated to quality excellence. We are driven to get better treatments to market, efficiently and responsibly by reducing timelines and delivering the highest quality products and services.

  

We are Abzena. More than a CDMO, we are a responsible and dedicated partner that takes care of your products from concept to patient.

  
  

The QA Associate – Environmental Monitoring is responsible for performing and coordinating environmental monitoring sampling, evaluating and trending environmental monitoring data, and preparing periodic trend reports. This role will work closely with the third-party lab to arrange sample pick up and track receipt of data reports.

This role will provide back-up assistance to the Quality Operations Team to support manufacturing, including batch record review, batch disposition activities, quality-on-the-floor oversight, and timely escalation of quality and compliance concerns. The associate works cross-functionally to maintain inspection readiness, ensure accurate GMP documentation, and support effective contamination control and continuous improvement.

* Plans and coordinates sampling activities with Manufacturing and other site functions to ensure required monitoring is completed on schedule.
* Ensures samples are correctly identified, handled, transferred, and documented with complete chain of custody and traceability. Coordinates pick up and testing with third-party lab.
* Escalates missed samples, adverse conditions, excursions, and other potential contamination-control concerns, as required. Supports investigations of alert and action level excursions, atypical results, and recurring contamination signals.
* Reviews environmental monitoring forms for completeness, accuracy, specification compliance, and emerging adverse trends.
* Prepares periodic environmental monitoring trend reports that summarize results, excursions, recurring observations, and recommended follow-up actions.
* Prepares the environmental monitoring content for monthly site management review slides, summarizing key metrics, trends, excursions, investigations, and risks.
* Supports the Quality Ops Team with review of executed batch records, batch disposition activities, quality on the floor, and completion of monthly quality walk throughs.

* Working knowledge of GMP regulations (US, EU, ROW), GDP, 21 CFR, USP, and applicable standards.

ca5355bf62127823e998.title: Associate Director, Quality Control
ca5355bf62127823e998.description:
Rezolute is a late-stage rare disease company focused on significantly improving outcomes for individuals with hypoglycemia caused by hyperinsulinism (HI). Our antibody therapy, RZ358 (ersodetug), is designed to treat all forms of HI and has shown substantial benefit in clinical trials and real-world use for the treatment of congenital hyperinsulinism (cHI) and tumor hyperinsulinism (tHI)

  

**Position Description**

This position is responsible for management of Rezolute’s clinical and commercial product testing program. The Associate Director, Quality Control acts as a liaison between Rezolute and its contract test laboratory (CTL) / CMO partners who perform our release and stability testing. The successful candidate will support Rezolute’s objectives by acting as a Quality Control subject matter expert during internal stakeholder collaborations and external team meetings.

  

**Principle Duties and Responsibilities Include:**

### **Manage data review program**

* Review raw data and data summaries provided by contract testing facilities
* Provide timely feedback to testing laboratories regarding necessary corrections to raw data and summaries
* Perform electronic data entry and verification

### **Manage reference standard and critical reagent program**

* Maintain inventory of reference standards and critical reagents at contract testing facilities
* Manage the qualification and requalification of new reference standards and critical reagents

### **Manage analytical method lifecycle**

* Design and maintain the analytical method monitoring program
* Recommend improvements to existing test methods
* Manage the transfer of test methods to contract laboratories including review and approval of protocols and reports
* Participate in the development and validation of new test methods

### **Initiate and review Quality System records**

* Review deviations, OOS/OOT investigations, supplier change notices and change control records as Quality Control subject matter expert
* Author, review and revise Quality Control SOPs
* Manage submission of Quality Control documents into electronic document management system

### **Support regulatory filings**

* Participate in the preparation of regulatory documents (e.g., IND, IMPD, BLA, NDA, MAA) and requests for information including data verification of content
* Participate in the preparation of Annual Product Quality Reviews including data verification of content
* **Other duties as assigned**



### **Qualifications/Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in biology, chemistry, biochemistry, microbiology, or related field
* 6+ years in pharmaceutical/biopharmaceutical Quality Control / Analytical Science environment; experience with biologics preferred
* Detailed knowledge of analytical techniques and compendial methods used for testing of proteins and small molecules
* Proficiency in GMP analytical data review
* Demonstrated understanding of laboratory investigation methodology for OOT and OOS results
* Demonstrated knowledge of GMP principles and regulatory guidance
* Competent technical writer with expertise in authoring method protocols and reports as well as SOPs and Quality System records (deviations, investigations, change controls)
* Prior use of a LIMS application or electronic database
* Proficient with Microsoft Applications (Word, Excel, Outlook, SharePoint, Teams, etc.)
* Data-driven mindset with eye for detail
* Robust problem-solving abilities
* Capable of maintaining direction while working independently

91985ee997cc8092b89c.title: Content Marketing Manager
91985ee997cc8092b89c.description:
HackerOne is a global leader in Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM). The HackerOne Platform unites agentic AI solutions with the ingenuity of the world’s largest community of security researchers to continuously discover, validate, prioritize, and remediate exposures across code, cloud, and AI systems. Through solutions like bug bounty, vulnerability disclosure, agentic pentesting, AI red teaming, and code security, HackerOne delivers measurable, continuous reduction of cyber risk for enterprises. Industry leaders, including Anthropic, Crypto.com, General Motors, Goldman Sachs, Lufthansa, Uber, UK Ministry of Defence, and the U.S. Department of Defense, trust HackerOne to safeguard their digital ecosystems. HackerOne was recognized in Gartner’s Emerging Tech Impact Radar: AI Cybersecurity Ecosystem report for its leadership in AI Security Testing and has been named a Most Loved Workplace for Young Professionals (2024).

HackerOne is at a pivotal inflection point in the security industry. Offensive security is no longer optional – it is the standard for forward-thinking companies that want to build trust and resilience in a world where AI-driven innovation and adversaries are moving faster than ever. With the industry shifting, HackerOne stands apart: we combine the ingenuity of the largest security research community with a best-in-class AI-powered platform, trusted by the world’s top organizations.

**HackerOne Values**

HackerOne is dedicated to fostering a strong and inclusive culture. HackerOne is **Customer Obsessed** and prioritizes customer outcomes in our decisions and actions. We **Default to Disclosure** by operating with transparency and integrity, ensuring trust and accountability. Employees, researchers, customers, and partners **Win Together** by fostering empowerment, inclusion, respect, and accountability.

**Position Summary**
--------------------

At HackerOne, great content starts with a great story. It’s how we make complex cybersecurity topics understandable, turn original research into insights people remember, and build trust with security leaders.

As our Content Marketing Manager, you’ll help find and tell those stories. You’ll lead key parts of our content program, including the HackerOne blog, annual research, search optimization, and editorial standards. You’ll work with experts across HackerOne to uncover interesting ideas, find the story in the data, and turn technical expertise into content that is clear, useful, and worth reading.

This role is part editor, part storyteller, and part content strategist. You’ll bring strong editorial judgment, curiosity, and an audience-first mindset to what we create, while using data, search insights, and AI tools to help our content reach the right people and make a measurable impact.

**What You Will Do**
--------------------

* Manage the HackerOne blog, including the editorial calendar, story development, publishing, optimization, and performance tracking.
* Lead the development of HackerOne’s annual research and flagship reports, finding the strongest stories in our data and working with internal experts and partners to turn those insights into compelling narratives.
* Find stories across HackerOne by interviewing subject matter experts, asking the right questions, and identifying perspectives that can strengthen our thought leadership.
* Turn complex cybersecurity topics into clear, engaging content for security leaders without losing the substance or expertise behind them.
* Help execute our answer engine optimization (AEO) and search engine optimization (SEO) strategy, using search data and audience insights to identify opportunities and improve content performance.
* Maintain and apply HackerOne’s Style Guide to ensure our content is clear, consistent, and distinctly HackerOne.
* Manage the content intake process, helping teams sharpen ideas, prioritize requests, and move strong stories from concept to publication.
* Multiply the impact of our best stories by adapting content for campaigns, social media, and audience engagement.
* Measure content performance and use those insights to understand what resonates with our audience and inform what we create next.
* Use AI tools throughout the content process to support research, idea development, drafting, editing, optimization, and repurposing while maintaining strong human editorial judgment.

**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------

* 3+ years of experience in content marketing, editorial, journalism, or a related role.
* A strong storyteller with demonstrated experience finding an interesting angle, building a clear narrative, and making complex subjects engaging and accessible.
* Excellent writing, editing, and interviewing skills, with strong editorial judgment and attention to detail.
* Experience developing research-driven content, reports, or thought leadership and turning data and expert insights into stories for a specific audience.
* Experience managing a content program, publication, or editorial calendar.
* Experience with SEO and/or AEO, including keyword research, content optimization, and performance measurement.
* Experience using AI tools to support content creation, research, optimization, or other marketing workflows.
* Strong collaboration and project management skills, with the ability to work across teams and bring ideas from concept to publication.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience creating content for B2B technology, cybersecurity, or another technical industry.
* A background in journalism, editorial, research, or another field where interviewing and story development are core skills.
* Familiarity with content and search performance tools such as Google Analytics, SEMrush, or similar tools.
* Experience adapting stories and content for social media and other marketing channels.
* Experience partnering with product marketing, demand generation, communications, or product teams.
* Curiosity about how search, AI, and changing audience behaviors are reshaping content and storytelling.

**Job Benefits:**
-----------------

* Health (medical, vision, dental), life, and disability insurance\*
* Equity stock options
* Retirement plans
* Paid public holidays and unlimited PTO
* Paid maternity and parental leave
* Leaves of absence (including caregiver leave and leave under CO's Healthy Families and Workplaces Act)
* Employee Assistance Program
* **Eligibility may differ by country**

We're committed to building a global team! For certain roles outside the United States, India, the U.K., and the Netherlands, we partner with Remote.com as our Employer of Record (EOR).

Visa/work permit sponsorship is not available.

*Employment at HackerOne is contingent on a background check.*

HackerOne is an Equal Opportunity Employer in the terms and conditions of employment for all employees and job applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, gender identity or gender expression, national origin, pregnancy, disability or veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by international, federal, state, or local laws.

This policy applies to all HackerOne employment practices, including hiring, recruiting, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, leave of absence, compensation, benefits, training, and apprenticeship. HackerOne makes hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time.

762e45b9241f7ce5ca03.description:
**Join our team as a Sales Development Representative and help virtualize biological experiments to accelerate discovery**!

**Location:** Remote - US East Coast

**About Turbine**

A lab without limits, built for biopharma.

Turbine’s Virtual Lab (vLab®) enables scientists to run Virtual Assays across millions of biological conditions far beyond traditional laboratory throughput. Instead of narrowing hypotheses to fit experimental constraints, scientists can explore the broader biological search space computationally before deciding what to validate in the wet lab. Turbine doesn’t replace the wet lab. It makes every experiment count. Through an integrated lab-in-the-loop workflow, virtual findings become testable hypotheses, with validation results feeding back to strengthen subsequent predictions within the workflow.

In deployed programs, Turbine has reduced decision timelines from 12-18 months to approximately two months while cutting wet-lab experiments by more than 50%.

Working with scientists at leading biopharma like MSD (Merck & Co.), AstraZeneca and Bayer, Turbine’s virtual assays have rationalized experiments across more than 30 discovery programs.

Backed by leading tech and industry investors like Accel, MSD Global Health Innovation Fund, Interactive Venture Partners and Beiersdorf, Turbine is turning biology into an engineering discipline.

**The Role**

As we scale our commercial organization, we are looking for a Sales Development Representative to help us systematically identify, engage and develop new opportunities across our target biopharma accounts.

The SDR will be responsible for building a qualified pipeline for Turbine's Business Development team.

This is not a high-volume, transactional SDR position. Turbine sells complex scientific solutions to sophisticated enterprise customers, often involving multiple scientific, technical and business stakeholders. Success therefore requires a thoughtful, account-based approach to business development.

You will work closely with Business Development and Marketing to identify priority accounts and stakeholders, develop targeted outreach, follow up on conferences and campaigns, and convert initial interest into qualified commercial conversations.

You will report into Business Development, with a dotted line to Sales Operations to ensure strong CRM discipline, pipeline tracking and reporting.

**Key Responsibilities**

Account Development & Prospecting

* Research and map priority pharmaceutical and biotechnology accounts.
* Identify relevant scientific, technical and business decision-makers within target organizations.
* Develop personalized outreach across email, LinkedIn and other appropriate channels.
* Generate qualified meetings for Turbine's Business Development team.
* Identify new opportunities within both new and existing accounts.
* Re-engage dormant prospects and previously identified opportunities.
* Work with Business Development to develop account-specific engagement strategies.

Conference & Marketing Follow-Up

* Work closely with Business Development and Marketing before major conferences to identify target companies and attendees.
* Support meeting generation ahead of conferences.
* Ensure rapid and systematic follow-up of conference leads and interactions.
* Follow up on webinars, white papers, publications and other marketing activity.
* Help convert marketing engagement into qualified commercial conversations.

Qualification & Pipeline Development

* Conduct initial qualification of inbound and outbound prospects.
* Understand the customer's scientific interests, therapeutic areas, programs and potential use cases.
* Hand qualified opportunities to the appropriate Business Development Manager with clear context and next steps.
* Track progression from initial engagement through qualified opportunity.

CRM & Sales Operations

* Maintain accurate and timely records in CRM (Hubspot)
* Ensure contacts, accounts, meetings, opportunities and follow-up activities are consistently captured.
* Work with Sales Operations to maintain data quality and appropriate sales processes.
* Support pipeline reporting and analysis.
* Help identify patterns in outreach, conversion and account engagement that can improve commercial performance.

  
**Requirements**

**You are a Turbiner if these personality traits apply to you**

* You have self-awareness and strong intention on personal growth
* You seek out feedback and learn from mistakes and apply what you learned
* You take responsibility and focus on the outcomes over tasks
* You focus on shared success and are open to challenging others respectfully to get the best possible outcome
* You are in it for the long haul and have passion for our mission

**Experience & Skills**

Required

* Experience in sales development, business development or a related commercial role.
* Experience using HubSpot, Salesforce or another modern CRM platform.
* Strong research skills and ability to understand complex organizations and stakeholder structures.
* Highly organized and disciplined approach to follow-up and pipeline management.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Comfortable engaging senior scientific and life sciences business professionals.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently and proactively.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across Business Development, Marketing, Product and Sales Operations.

Preferred

* Experience within biotechnology, pharmaceutical, life sciences, AI/drug discovery or scientific software.
* Familiarity with pharmaceutical R&D organizations and drug discovery workflows.
* Experience with account-based sales or marketing approaches.
* Experience supporting enterprise sales teams with long, complex sales cycles.
* Scientific or life-sciences education is advantageous but not essential.

  
**Benefits**

**Compensation:**

Base salary: $65K - $80K, OTE: $90-$115K (base + variable commission)

**Benefits:**

* HO allowance $410: You can spend your amount within your first 6 months. Purchase the item for your home office (desk, ergonomic chair, router, etc.).
* 401(k) with company match
* Comprehensive medical coverage, dental, and vision options
* You are also eligible for 20 paid vacation days each calendar year accrued per pay period plus 8 days of paid sick leave per calendar year

0031b9b50219d7bca6dd.title: Entertainment Coordinator & In House DJ
0031b9b50219d7bca6dd.company: Normandy Farm Hotel/Blue Bell County Club
0031b9b50219d7bca6dd.description:
Description:

We are seeking a motivated, organized, and experienced **Entertainment Coordinator & In-House DJ** to lead the day-to-day operations and continued development of our DJ and photo booth services.

This position combines hands-on DJ performance with entertainment department leadership, team development, equipment management, event coordination, marketing, and business development. The ideal candidate is both a talented DJ and a strong operational leader who takes pride in delivering exceptional client experiences, developing talented team members, and creating systems that allow a department to operate efficiently and consistently.  
As the primary in-house DJ and Entertainment Coordinator, you will serve as a key resource for our DJs, photo booth technicians, sales and planning team, and studio management. You will help ensure that every event is properly staffed, every team member is prepared, and all entertainment equipment is maintained to the highest standard.

**Key Responsibilities**

**DJ Performance & Event Execution**

* Serve as the studio's primary in-house DJ, performing a minimum of 40 studio DJ events annually, subject to bookings, scheduling, approved time off, and availability.
* Deliver professional, engaging DJ services that reflect the studio's brand and service standards.
* Collaborate with the Sales & Planning department on DJ consultations, music selections, custom mashups, and event formalities.
* Assist with troubleshooting event-flow concerns, formality timing, sound requirements and restrictions, DJ setup needs, and photo booth placement.
* Help ensure that all entertainment services are prepared, coordinated, and executed professionally.

**Entertainment Department Leadership & Coordination**

  

* Oversee the day-to-day operational readiness and quality of the studio's DJ and photo booth departments.
* Serve as the primary operational point of contact for DJs and photo booth technicians.
* Communicate studio procedures, event expectations, equipment requirements, and service standards clearly to entertainment personnel.
* Help ensure that all events are appropriately staffed and prepared.
* Monitor service quality, review client feedback, and identify recurring issues, training needs, and opportunities for improvement.
* Work with studio management to address performance concerns and resolve service-related issues.
* Develop systems and procedures that allow the department to operate efficiently without relying on any single individual.
* Create and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs), troubleshooting guides, and other resources for DJs and photo booth technicians.

**DJ Recruiting, Training & Development**  

* Identify, recruit, interview, and evaluate DJs who align with the studio's brand and service expectations.
* Train new DJs on studio procedures, equipment, client service, event preparation, and performance standards.
* Mentor developing DJs and provide ongoing coaching to improve performance.
* Conduct periodic training sessions and identify team members who would benefit from additional development.
* Help cultivate DJs who become highly skilled, independently reliable, and desirable to clients.
* Maintain a qualified roster of DJs that supports the studio's booking volume and minimizes lost business due to staffing limitations.

  
**Photo Booth Operations & Team Management**  

* Recruit, train, and retain reliable photo booth technicians.
* Maintain an adequate roster of qualified technicians to support scheduled events.
* Confirm technician assignments and communicate event details, procedures, and expectations.
* Ensure technicians have the appropriate equipment, supplies, and information for each event.
* Conduct periodic photo booth training and onboarding sessions.
* Troubleshoot operational challenges and identify recurring issues that require improved training or updated procedures.
* Maintain consistent service standards across all photo booth events.

  
**Equipment & Inventory Management**  

* Maintain an accurate inventory of all studio-owned DJ and photo booth equipment.
* Ensure equipment is properly maintained, tested, organized, charged where applicable, and ready for upcoming events.
* Establish and enforce procedures for equipment checkout, return, inspection, and storage.
* Inspect returned equipment and confirm that it is accounted for and returned to its designated location.
* Identify missing, damaged, aging, or unreliable equipment and communicate repair or replacement needs to management.
* Maintain adequate photo booth supplies and other consumable inventory.
* Establish accountability procedures for equipment used by subcontract DJs and photo booth technicians.
* The goal is to maintain an event-ready inventory at all times and prevent avoidable equipment issues on event days.

  
**Standard Operating Procedures & Department Systems**  
Develop, document, and maintain written SOPs that support consistent service delivery, efficient training, and operational accountability.  
SOPs will include, but are not limited to:  

* Entertainment Coordinator responsibilities and procedures.
* DJ event preparation, execution, and equipment requirements.
* Photo booth technician procedures, setup, and breakdown.
* Equipment checkout, return, inspection, and storage.
* New DJ and photo booth technician onboarding and training.
* Weekend escalation and event issue reporting procedures.
* Troubleshooting guides and equipment accountability standards.
* These systems should make it easier to onboard new team members, maintain consistent standards, and empower staff to resolve routine issues independently.

**Weekend Coordination & Operational Support**  

* Serve as the studio's primary weekend coordinator and point of contact for entertainment-related and reasonable event-related operational issues when not working an off-site event.
* Provide reasonable assistance with time-sensitive staffing, equipment, event execution, and client concerns.
* When DJing an event at Normandy Farm, remain available to assist with reasonable studio-related issues when circumstances allow.
* Help resolve or escalate DJ staffing problems, photo booth technician issues, equipment failures, event-day questions, and client concerns requiring management attention.
* Document significant incidents and communicate recurring issues to studio management.
* Develop procedures and training that enable DJs and photo booth technicians to resolve routine matters independently.
* The focus of weekend coordination is to provide appropriate operational support while building a team capable of handling everyday responsibilities without unnecessary escalation.

  
**Marketing, Content & Business Development**  

* Create and publish entertainment-related social media content on a weekly basis, including content focused on DJs, photo booths, and video services.
* Capture or coordinate engaging entertainment content from events when appropriate.
* Coordinate with subcontractors to obtain event photos, videos, and other content for marketing purposes.
* Create and maintain Spotify playlists and mixes that can be shared through the studio website, social media, and sales process.
* Provide the sales and marketing teams with DJ profiles, music ideas, event footage, and relevant client feedback.
* Assist with studio open houses and other promotional events as needed.
* Identify opportunities to improve the visibility, presentation, and marketability of the studio's entertainment services.

  
**Additional Administrative & Studio Support**  

* Perform equipment, training, marketing, administrative, and business-development tasks during periods with fewer scheduled events.
* Assist with web-based administrative projects and other reasonable studio support responsibilities during slower periods.
* Collaborate with studio management and other departments to support overall business operations and service quality.
* Work Schedule & Availability  
  This is a full-time position that combines weekday studio responsibilities with evening and weekend DJ events. The work schedule will vary based on the studio's event calendar, operational needs, and booking volume.

**Event weeks:** Scheduled DJ events will count toward the regular work schedule and will generally replace office hours during those weeks.

**Adjusted weekdays:** During weeks with multiple Friday, Saturday, and/or Sunday events, the remaining schedule will be adjusted accordingly. This may result in two weekdays off during the following week, depending on hours worked and studio needs.

**Non-event weeks:** More time will be dedicated to studio operations, equipment management, training, marketing, administration, and business development.

**Scheduling coordination:** Office days, event days, and days off will be coordinated with studio management. Proposed days off must be submitted to Jessica at least one week in advance.

Flexibility, communication, and proactive scheduling are essential to success in this role.

  
Requirements:

* Strong DJ skills and a commitment to delivering exceptional event experiences.
* Excellent organizational, communication, and leadership abilities.
* Experience coordinating events, managing equipment, training team members, or overseeing entertainment operations.
* The ability to recruit, develop, and motivate a team of DJs and photo booth technicians.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to remain calm and effective under event-day pressure.

ad52bcab58fd5c216efe.description:
Barsz Gowie Amon & Fultz LLC (BGA&F) is seeking a professional, organized, and service-oriented Office Support Coordinator to join our administrative team. This position plays an important role in creating a welcoming environment for clients and employees while supporting our office's daily operations.

***If you enjoy working with people, staying organized, and helping an office run smoothly, we encourage you to apply!***

**Position Overview**

The Office Support Coordinator serves as a primary point of contact for clients, visitors, and staff while providing general office and administrative support. This role helps maintain an organized, professional, and well-equipped workplace by coordinating reception, telephone calls, mail, office supplies, meeting logistics, and other day-to-day office needs.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Reception & Customer Service**

* Welcome clients and visitors, notify staff of arrivals, and provide a professional first impression.
* Answer and route incoming telephone calls, take accurate messages, and direct inquiries to the appropriate team members.
* Maintain an organized reception area and help coordinate front desk coverage.
* Ensure conference rooms and common areas are prepared for meetings.

**Office Operations & Facilities**

* Receive, sort, distribute, and prepare outgoing mail and deliveries.
* Coordinate routine shipping, postage, and courier services.
* Monitor office supply inventory and submit replenishment requests.
* Coordinate routine maintenance and repairs for printers, copiers, and other office equipment.
* Help maintain a clean, organized, and welcoming office environment.

**Administrative & Team Support**

* Provide general administrative support, including copying, filing, data entry, and scheduling assistance.
* Coordinate meeting arrangements, including room setup, schedules, and necessary materials.
* Assist with company events, including preparation, setup, and cleanup.
* Support new employee onboarding logistics, including workspace readiness and office supplies.
* Assist with special projects and seasonal office tasks as assigned.

**Qualifications & Skills**

* Previous experience in reception, front desk, office administration, or a similar customer-facing role preferred.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Professional demeanor and a customer-service-oriented approach.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Word, and Excel.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, handle interruptions, and work independently.
* Dependable, adaptable, and able to work collaboratively with a team.
* Ability to handle confidential information with discretion and follow established procedures.

**What We're Looking For**

We are looking for someone who takes pride in being dependable, helpful, and organized. The ideal candidate enjoys assisting others, anticipates office needs, communicates professionally, and understands how reliable office support contributes to an effective and positive workplace.

**Work Environment & Requirements**

* Non-exempt, hourly position.
* No supervisory responsibilities.
* Primarily office-based, with prolonged periods of sitting and working at a computer.
* Ability to lift up to 15 pounds occasionally.

**Equal Employment Opportunity**

Barsz Gowie Amon & Fultz LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to creating an inclusive workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable law.

Overview:

Thank you for considering IT Concepts dba Kentro, where innovation drives opportunity and collaboration leads to success. Our dynamic community of experts is fully committed to advancing our customers' missions, fostering professional growth, and making a positive impact on our communities.

By joining our supportive community, you will find that Kentro is dedicated to your personal and professional development. Together, we can drive meaningful change, spark innovation, and achieve extraordinary milestones.

Kentro is hiring for a **Deputy Service Reliability and Operations Manager** to support the **VA ESOM contract**. This role serves in a dual capacity, providing enterprise-level operational leadership as Deputy to the Service Reliability & Operations Manager while maintaining direct responsibility for the Major Incident Management (MIM) workstream.

As Deputy, this position will support the coordination, performance, and continuous improvement of enterprise monitoring and service reliability operations spanning monitoring, instrumentation, event management, incident response, and related operational functions. The Deputy will work closely with functional leaders to align priorities, address operational risks, coordinate cross-team dependencies, and ensure consistent execution across a large, distributed 24x7 operating environment.

As the MIM Project Manager, this position will lead the Major Incident Management team and be accountable for staffing, schedule, deliverables, performance, risk management, stakeholder coordination, and continuous improvement of the MIM function.

**Location: R****emote** - This position can be performed remotely within the United States and will support Eastern Time working hours.

**Compensation Range:** The anticipated base salary range for this position is $120,000 –$170,000 annually and reflects Kentro’s good-faith expectations at the time of posting. Final compensation is determined based on the role’s requirements, relevant skills, experience, education, certifications, work location, applicable security clearance requirements, market conditions, internal equity, and contract requirements.

This Job Description reflects the primary duties of the role; however, it is not intended to be all‑inclusive. Team members may be asked to take on additional responsibilities in alignment with customer expectations, business needs, and Kentro’s culture of collaboration and adaptability.

Responsibilities:

Deputy Service Reliability & Operations Management

* Serve as Deputy to the Service Reliability & Operations Manager and provide leadership continuity across enterprise monitoring and service reliability operations.
* Support execution of organizational priorities across application monitoring, sustainment, event management, major incident management, and related operational workstreams.
* Coordinate with functional managers to align priorities, staffing, performance expectations, deliverables, and operational dependencies.
* Identify operational risks, performance gaps, resource constraints, and cross-team dependencies and coordinate corrective actions with the appropriate leaders.
* Develop and maintain management reporting, performance measures, operational reviews, and improvement plans.
* Exercise delegated management authority and support decision-making as required.

Major Incident Management Project Leadership

* Lead the Major Incident Management workstream and maintain accountability for staffing, schedule, priorities, deliverables, risks, and stakeholder coordination.
* Track MIM performance against established metrics and service-level requirements, including MTTR, response times, incident volume, resolution efficiency, and quality measures.
* Ensure MIM deliverables, reports, documentation, and operational records are accurate, complete, and delivered on schedule.
* Identify recurring issues, process gaps, and operational trends and coordinate corrective actions with appropriate technical and management teams.
* Maintain effective working relationships with VA stakeholders, program leadership, and cross-functional ESOM teams.

Operational Performance and Continuous Improvement

* Establish and monitor KPIs, dashboards, trends, risks, and corrective actions across assigned operational areas.
* Use operational data to identify opportunities to improve service reliability, incident response, alert effectiveness, and organizational performance.
* Coordinate cross-functional improvement initiatives and ensure actions, owners, dependencies, and milestones remain visible and tracked through completion.
* Support adoption and consistent execution of ITIL-aligned Incident, Problem, Change, and continuous improvement practices.
* Promote standardization, automation, and process maturity across enterprise monitoring and incident management functions.

Leadership and Stakeholder Management

* Establish clear performance expectations and reinforce accountability, collaboration, and operational discipline.
* Provide clear, concise status reporting and leadership briefings regarding performance, risks, staffing, incidents, and improvement initiatives.
* Build strong working relationships with VA customers, Kentro leadership, peer managers, technical teams, and other ESOM stakeholders.
* Escalate significant operational, staffing, delivery, and customer risks to program leadership as appropriate.

  
Qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, engineering, business, or another related discipline; additional relevant experience may be substituted where permitted by contract requirements.
* 10+ years of relevant experience in enterprise IT operations, service reliability, incident management, infrastructure operations, or related disciplines.
* 5+ years of management or project leadership experience, including responsibility for multidisciplinary or geographically distributed teams.
* Experience managing staffing, schedules, deliverables, risks, performance measures, and stakeholder relationships.
* Strong knowledge of ITIL-based service management practices, particularly Incident and Major Incident Management.
* Experience working across technical and operational teams to resolve complex service issues and improve service delivery.
* Strong analytical, organizational, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with technical teams, senior leadership, and customer stakeholders.
* Ability to manage competing priorities and operate effectively during high-impact, time-sensitive events.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

c7bfc0940748593a8173.title: Promotional Products Operations Coordinator
c7bfc0940748593a8173.description:
**About IMC Designs**

IMC Designs operates in the advertising specialties and promotional products industry, helping businesses promote their brands through customized merchandise and branded products. Promotional merchandise can support corporate marketing campaigns, customer appreciation programs, employee recognition initiatives, trade shows, business events, and other brand-building activities.

Coordinating these services requires accurate product information, organized customer orders, timely communication, supplier coordination, and careful attention to customization requirements and delivery schedules.

We are seeking a detail-oriented and organized Promotional Products Operations Coordinator to support the day-to-day coordination of promotional product orders, supplier communications, order documentation, and customer requirements. This position is ideal for a professional who enjoys managing multiple priorities, maintaining accurate records, resolving operational issues, and helping ensure that promotional products move efficiently from order placement through fulfillment.

**Job Summary**

IMC Designs is seeking a Promotional Products Operations Coordinator to help manage the administrative and operational processes associated with customized promotional merchandise and branded product orders.

The coordinator will support order entry, product specification reviews, supplier follow-ups, order status tracking, artwork and customization coordination, shipment monitoring, and customer communication. The role will help ensure that product details, quantities, pricing information, customization instructions, and delivery requirements are accurately documented and communicated to the appropriate parties.

Working with sales representatives, customers, suppliers, designers, and fulfillment partners, the coordinator will help identify order discrepancies, follow up on outstanding information, monitor production and delivery timelines, and maintain organized records throughout the order lifecycle.

This position is well suited for an organized professional with experience in operations coordination, order management, administrative support, customer service, purchasing, or production coordination. Familiarity with promotional products, branded merchandise, print production, or advertising services is beneficial but not required.

**Why Join Our Team?**

* Join IMC Designs and develop valuable operations experience in the advertising services and promotional products industry. As a Promotional Products Operations Coordinator, you will help support the processes that turn customer branding requirements into completed promotional product orders.
* You will gain practical experience in order management, supplier communication, product customization coordination, delivery tracking, and customer support while working with multiple stakeholders to keep projects organized and moving forward.
* The work arrangement offers the opportunity to perform coordination and administrative responsibilities from an approved remote location while developing transferable skills in operations, procurement support, account coordination, and order fulfillment. Compensation, equipment provisions, and other employment benefits will be confirmed by the employer.

**Responsibilities**

* Coordinate promotional product orders from initial order documentation through production, shipment, and fulfillment.
* Enter, review, and maintain accurate order records, including customer information, product descriptions, quantities, pricing, customization details, shipping addresses, and requested delivery dates.
* Review product specifications, artwork instructions, imprint methods, color requirements, and branding details to identify missing information or potential discrepancies before orders proceed.
* Communicate with suppliers and vendors to obtain product availability updates, pricing information, production timelines, artwork approvals, and shipment details.
* Track order progress and maintain updated records of pending approvals, production status, backorders, shipping information, and expected delivery dates.
* Coordinate the exchange of artwork files, logos, proofs, and customization instructions among customers, designers, sales representatives, and suppliers.
* Follow up on outstanding customer approvals, supplier confirmations, purchase orders, and other documentation required to keep orders moving forward.
* Monitor production and delivery schedules, identify potential delays, and communicate changes to the appropriate internal teams and customers.
* Assist with preparing and reviewing purchase orders, order confirmations, invoices, shipping documents, and other operational records as assigned.
* Maintain organized electronic files, order documentation, supplier information, and customer communication records using company-approved systems.
* Coordinate with sales and account management teams to clarify customer requirements, resolve order discrepancies, and support timely customer updates.
* Help investigate issues involving incorrect product specifications, missing merchandise, delayed shipments, customization errors, or incomplete order documentation.
* Maintain spreadsheets, trackers, and operational reports that provide visibility into order status, outstanding tasks, supplier responses, and fulfillment progress.
* Support invoice and order reconciliation by comparing documented product quantities, pricing, shipping charges, and order details when applicable.
* Prioritize multiple orders and deadlines while maintaining accuracy and clear communication in a remote work environment.
* Identify opportunities to improve order tracking, documentation standards, supplier follow-up procedures, and other operational workflows.
* Handle customer, supplier, pricing, and business information responsibly in accordance with company policies.
* Perform additional administrative and operational coordination duties as needed to support promotional product order fulfillment.

**Requirements**

* High school diploma or equivalent required; an associate or bachelor's degree in business administration, operations management, supply chain management, or a related field is preferred.
* Approximately 1–3 years of experience in operations coordination, order processing, customer service, purchasing support, administrative operations, production coordination, or a similar role preferred.
* Experience maintaining accurate records and coordinating multiple orders, projects, requests, or deadlines.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, particularly when reviewing product specifications, quantities, pricing, customization requirements, and delivery information.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Word, Outlook, or Google Workspace for managing spreadsheets, correspondence, documentation, and order trackers.
* Familiarity with order management systems, customer relationship management (CRM) platforms, inventory systems, purchasing software, or project management tools is an advantage.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills for coordinating with customers, suppliers, designers, sales teams, and fulfillment partners.
* Ability to follow up proactively on outstanding information, identify discrepancies, and help resolve operational issues before they affect order completion.
* Strong time-management skills and the ability to organize competing priorities in a remote work environment.
* Ability to work independently, maintain productivity, and communicate progress effectively without continuous direct supervision.
* Reliable internet access and a suitable remote workspace, subject to the employer's remote-work requirements.
* Experience with promotional products, branded merchandise, custom apparel, print production, corporate gifts, or advertising services is preferred but not required.
* Ability to learn product terminology, customization processes, supplier procedures, order workflows, and company-specific business systems.
* Commitment to accuracy, customer service, confidentiality, and consistent follow-through.

**Additional Benefits**

* This position offers an opportunity to build practical experience in promotional products operations, order coordination, supplier communication, and customer support within the advertising services industry.
* The role also provides opportunities to develop transferable skills in order management, procurement support, project coordination, and fulfillment operations that can support future career growth.

Join our team as a Promotional Products Operations Coordinator if you’re passionate about streamlining processes, leading innovative programs, and delivering exceptional promotional solutions that elevate our brand presence!

Pay: $20.00 - $25.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Remote

4982c7923d7db93c7f4d.title: Sales Operations Specialist (100% Remote)
4982c7923d7db93c7f4d.description:
Since our founding in 2011, our mission has been to improve the lives of seniors and their caregivers. We are deeply passionate about communication and committed to becoming the foremost provider of services and solutions that enable seniors to lead more meaningful and independent lives. We also understand the power of connection and the profound impact it has on the lives of individuals who are hard-of-hearing. By utilizing enhanced automatic speech recognition, human captioning, and innovative product development, we deliver easy-to-use, cutting-edge technology to our primarily senior customer base. Our near real-time phone captioning technology allows individuals with hearing loss to see what callers are saying, enabling them to regain their connection to the world.
  
  
ClearCaptions is a Federal Communications Commission (FCC)-certified telephone captioning provider, adhering to the highest industry standards of privacy, security, and professionalism. We recognize the importance of maintaining the trust and confidence of our customers, and we continually strive to exceed their expectations.
  
For more information about our services please visit clearcaptions.com.
  
  
**The kind of people we look for:**  

* Versatile people who thrive on variety and challenge
* Excited about working in a fast-paced environment.
* Innate problem solvers who want to grow in a flexible, collaborative culture.
* Takes initiative, pushes boundaries, motivated to innovate.
* Individuals with a growth mindset who want to use their learning and relationship-building skills.
* Align with our company core values: Integrity, Accountability, Collaboration, Service and Quality.

**Summary:**  
The Sales Operations Specialist serves as a key operational partner to the Sales organization by coordinating reporting, systems support, process administration, and performance tracking activities. The role maintains sales performance metrics, supports customer relationship management (CRM) and business systems, assists with sales events and enablement initiatives, and coordinates cross-functional projects to help improve productivity, efficiency, and execution. Through accurate reporting, effective communication, and operational support, the position helps ensure sales teams have the tools, information, and resources needed to achieve business goals.
  
  
**What This Role Does:**  
Sales Operations, Analytics & Business Performance
  

* Maintains sales performance reports, dashboards, scorecards, and key performance indicator (KPI) tracking tools.
* Compiles and analyzes sales activity, conversion rates, installations, cancellations, and revenue data to support reporting needs.
* Prepares reporting, analysis, and presentation materials to support sales leadership meetings, business reviews, and operational initiatives.
* Performs data validation and reporting audits to help ensure data accuracy and integrity.

Sales Process, Systems & Operational Excellence
  

* Leads and supports initiatives designed to improve sales processes, operational efficiency, and workflow effectiveness.
* Develops, updates, and maintains standard operating procedures (SOPs), documentation, and process guides.
* Assists with the administration of Salesforce and other sales systems, including reporting support, data maintenance, and user assistance.
* Partners with Business Operations and Technology teams to support system enhancements, process updates, and user adoption efforts.

Sales Enablement, Event Operations & Field Support
  

* Coordinates operational activities for sales events, lead generation programs, and community outreach initiatives.
* Develops, tracks, and reports event performance metrics, including attendance, leads, conversions, installations, and revenue results.
* Assists with event logistics, inventory management, materials preparation, and budget tracking.
* Maintains sales enablement resources, onboarding materials, and field support tools to promote consistent execution across sales teams.

Cross-Functional Project Leadership
  

* Leads and supports cross-functional projects involving Sales, Marketing, Finance, Training, Recruiting, Technology, and Business Operations.
* Coordinates project activities, timelines, communications, and deliverables to support successful implementation.
* Assists with tracking project progress, identifying potential issues, and escalating concerns as appropriate.
* Performs other duties as assigned.

**What You Will Bring:**  

* An associate degree is required; a bachelor's degree is preferred. Equivalent combinations of education and relevant experience may be considered.
* A minimum of five (5) years of experience in sales operations, business operations, sales enablement, or related fields.
* Strong knowledge of sales operations principles, performance management, forecasting, pipeline analysis, and KPI reporting.
* Knowledge of CRM platforms, sales technologies, reporting tools, and data management practices, including Salesforce and business intelligence solutions.
* Experience in analyzing complex data sets, identifying trends, and translating findings into actionable business recommendations.
* Skilled in developing dashboards, scorecards, reports, and performance metrics that support operational and strategic decision-making.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across Sales, Marketing, Finance, Technology, Training, Recruiting, and Business Operations functions to create a high-quality, results-driven, team-oriented environment.
* Excellent verbal and written communication, presentation, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to communicate complex information clearly through presentations, reports, and executive summaries.

27f3001dbbd495af07ad.description:
Overview:

At TDS Telecom, connecting people is at the heart of everything we do. We are forward thinkers who leverage cutting-edge fiber internet technology to strengthen communities. We are dedicated to excellence, which drives us to succeed together, creating a better world through meaningful connections. Ready to make an impact?

As the **Specialist - OSP** **Analyst I**, you will provide outside plant project support for a geographic area. This role will work closely with our internal and external partners supporting construction projects by monitoring and auditing the inbound shipments and utilization of materials. Additionally, you will maintain inventory levels and ensure accuracy in applicable tracking systems. You will handle bill of materials and work with partners to ensure applicable receipt of construction materials with a high degree of accuracy.

This position will also be providing administrative support to internal teams to track outside plant build status, build milestones as well as utilizing trends to forecast. The Specialist - OSP Analyst will identify process and system improvements used to compile our construction/material reporting. Position will also include, but not be limited to support for outside plant construction efforts.

**This position offers remote work flexibility; however, preference will be given to candidates located within 60 miles of Appleton, Wisconsin to support in-market needs. Occasional travel to job sites and warehouse sites up to 30% of the time, or as required.**

*This position can be hired at a Specialist-OSP Analyst (2026-29982) or Specialist-OSP Analyst I (2026-29983) level depending on the skills and qualifications of the candidate. Separate job postings outline the minimum requirements for each role. Please review both postings and apply to any level for which you are qualified and interested.*

Responsibilities:

* Submits Bill of Materials (BOM) submissions required for construction project procurement. Tracks shipments and monitors damaged goods upon receipt.
* Utilization of internal GIS and material platforms to extract/submit BOMs, monitor utilization, and reconcile construction material quantities.
* Tracking of usage and remaining inventory at storage location. Ensure our inventory and usage tools are kept current (SAP, TPAT).
* Helps maintain appropriate inventory levels for applicable market and projects.
* Conduct cycle inventory counts and performs annual reconciliation as directed.
* Maintains records, documentation, and files critical to business and financial operations. Duties include filing, archiving, or retrieving records as required in support of audits, financial reporting, or other business operations. This includes working with Finance to maintain accurate and appropriate inventory levels.
* Coordinate with internal teams for the disposal, transfer, or recycling of materials as needed.

Qualifications:

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelors degree (or higher) -OR- 4+ years professional work experience.
* 4+ years of utility construction experience -AND/OR- engineering experience
* 1+ years of analytical experience
* Must have and maintain a valid driver’s license, reliable transportation and insurance.

**Other Qualifications**

* Experience with inventory management preferred
* Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously
* Excellent written and oral communications skills
* Computer skills, including Microsoft Office Suite and the ability to learn new tools (i.e.: GIS, UTS, Clarity, etc.) as they are deployed.
* + Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel preferred
* Ability to maintain a high degree of confidentiality.
* Organized, self-motivated, detail orientated, analytical, able to work with minimal supervision.
* SAP Experience/knowledge
* 2+ years of telecommunications experience
* Project Management experience/exposure

Do you meet the Required Qualifications but are unsure if your experience aligns with the Other Qualifications? We encourage you to apply! Research shows that many candidates hesitate to apply unless they meet 100% of the qualifications, even when they possess the skills and experience needed to succeed in the role. Experience and skills come in many forms, and they may not always match exactly what’s listed on paper, but they can still lead to success. If you meet the Required Qualifications and believe you have the potential to thrive in this role, we encourage you to apply today!

**Benefits**

Associates scheduled to work 20 or more hours per week have access to medical, dental, vision, life insurance, a 401(k) plan, education assistance, and paid time off benefits such as vacation (15 days accrued per year for full-time; pro-rated for associates working between 20-39 hours), sick leave (10 days accrued per year for full-time and pro-rated for all other associates), seven paid national holidays and one floating holiday, paid parental leave (6 weeks after 12 months of employment), among others. Short Term Disability and Long Term Disability coverage is also available for associates working 30 or more hours per week. Associates scheduled to work under twenty hours per week or for a limited term (i.e. interns) are eligible for medical coverage, the 401(k) plan (if 18 or older), as well as sick leave (10 days accrued per year for full-time and pro-rated for all other associates).

Click here for more specific information regarding our comprehensive well-being program.

**Who is TDS Telecom?**

TDS Telecom provides high-speed internet, TV entertainment, and phone services to a diverse range of communities, including small to mid-sized urban, suburban, and rural areas across the U.S. With over 50 years of experience, TDS is committed to building and expanding fiber optic networks that bring cutting-edge connectivity to neighborhoods nationwide. Serving over 1 million connections, our mission is to create a better world by delivering innovative communication solutions that enhance the way people live, work, and connect. Visit tdstelecom.com to learn more!

At TDS, we are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) and value the difference of backgrounds, experiences and perspectives in our workforce.
